column1: The Buraq is a Clan medium-weight Quad battle armor, which was designed by Clan Hell's Horses during the early thirty-second century. The horselike Buraq was named for the mystical steed from ancient times, and like its mystical namesake, the battle armor is noted for its high ground speed. Typically, Clan Hell's Horses have used full Stars consisting of different variants of the battle armor. These Buraq Stars work as a team in their appointed mission assignments. They've been utilized on the Horses' Periphery borders to help scout and pin down pirates terrorizing their worlds. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.93 Can only be transported by internal bays, can not melee, can not swarm.
column2: Buraq 是地狱之马氏族在 32 世纪初设计的氏族中型四足战斗装甲。它以古代神话中的神骏命名，同样以极高的地面速度著称。地狱之马通常会用不同变体组成完整星群，让这些 Buraq 星群在各自任务中协同作战。它们被部署在地狱之马的边缘领地，用于侦察并钉住骚扰星球的海盗。 特性：改进通信 部署费用倍率：0.93 只能由内部舱室运输，不可近战，不可群袭。

column1: Part of the Serpentus series of OmniVehicles. The Wraith Superheavy Hovercraft is designed as a Stealthed Support Platform. Equipped with an Experimental Vehicular Null Signature System, 24 tons of Turret podspace and a generous 6 tons of munitions secured in a CASE. Unlike other Word of Blake Tanks this does not have a DNI despite its Advanced Electronics. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 7/11 hexes / 210/330 meters. Armor: Vehicle Adv. Stealth Structure: Vehicle Composite Values A S Front 220 70 Left 210 70 Right 210 70 Rear 150 70 Turret 200 70 Total 990 350 Quirk: Main Battle Tank Omni Vehicle
column2: Wraith 是 Serpentus 系列全能载具的一员。这台超重型悬浮艇被设计成隐形支援平台，配备实验型载具无信号系统、24 吨炮塔挂载舱，以及由 CASE 保护的充足 6 吨弹药。与其他 Blake 之言坦克不同，它虽然拥有先进电子设备，却没有 DNI。 生物群系限制：无。 移动力：7/11 格 / 210/330 米。 装甲：载具高级隐形 结构：载具复合结构 数值 前 后 前方 220 70 左侧 210 70 右侧 210 70 后方 150 70 炮塔 200 70 总计 990 350 特性：主战坦克 全能载具

column1: The 125-ton Hyaenodont OmniMech is a long-range support platform fielded by the Minnesota Tribe and constructed by Twin Forge Assemblies. Built on an Endo-Steel frame and powered by a 355-rated XL engine, it specializes in providing withering fire support from a distance, often anchoring the rear line of superheavy formations. It is clad in Ferro-Silk armor, a fragile yet lightweight steel-polymer lattice developed by Northern Meshworks, allowing for greater weapon mass at the expense of durability, consistent with the Tribe’s doctrine of prioritizing firepower above protection. Its name comes from an ancient Terran apex predator known for its bone-crushing bite and grim persistence, an icon preserved in Clan Wolverine mythos. Revived as a 'Mech by the Tribe, the Hyaenodont reflects their philosophy of overwhelming force and relentless pressure, hammering enemies down until there’s nothing left to resist.
column2: 125 吨的 Hyaenodont 全能机甲是明尼苏达部落部署的远程支援平台，由 Twin Forge Assemblies 建造。它采用内骨骼框架和 355 级 XL 引擎，专精于从远距离提供猛烈火力，常作为超重型编队的后卫支点。它披覆 Ferro-Silk 装甲，这种由 Northern Meshworks 开发的钢聚合物晶格轻薄却脆弱，以耐久性换取更大的武器重量，符合部落重火力、轻防护的理念。它的名字来自 Terra 古代一种以碎骨利齿和顽强意志闻名的顶级掠食者，也是狼氏族神话中保存的象征。部落将其复活为机甲后，Hyaenodont 体现了以压倒性力量和持续压力碾碎敌人的理念，直到对手再无抵抗之力。

column1: The Hitman was designed to work as a spotter 'Mech for advanced Arrow IV missile artillery rounds. In order to do this, the 'Mech is built to be able to close to effective range for its Forward-1 Target Acquisition Gear spotting gear rapidly with a Kagushima 210 XL propelling it up to 118.8 km/h and a MASC system pushing the 'Mech up to 151.2 km/h in short bursts. The 'Mech also carries an Apple Churchill Guardian ECM Suite to foul any enemy electronics warfare equipment and a Wunderland Beagle Active Probe to detect any hidden enemy units. With the recent invention of semi-guided LRMs the Hitman can also guide LRM fire to a unit targeted with its TAG unit. The Hitman carries five tons of armor protection to protect it against any attacks that may hit it. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: Hitman 的设计目标是为先进 Arrow IV 导弹炮弹充当前导标定机甲。为此，它采用 Kagushima 210 XL 引擎，最高速度可达 118.8 公里/小时，再用 MASC 在短时间内推高至 151.2 公里/小时，以便迅速进入 Forward-1 目标获取设备的有效标定距离。它还携带 Apple Churchill Guardian ECM 套件，干扰敌方电子战设备，并配备 Wunderland Beagle 主动探测器，发现隐藏单位。半制导 LRM 发明后，Hitman 还能利用 TAG 为指定目标引导 LRM 火力。它装有 5 吨装甲，保护自身免受攻击。 特性：稳定武器 部署费用倍率：0.99 手臂执行器限制：左下臂

column1: The Smilodon is a 110-ton line BattleMech fielded by the Minnesota Tribe, produced by Independence Weaponry as a dependable frontline brawler. Named after the prehistoric saber-toothed predator, the Smilodon symbolizes brutal efficiency and predatory focus, traits the Tribe values in its martial tradition. Its design draws inspiration from the Ebon Jaguar, sharing a low-slung, forward-thrusting posture and a menacing profile suited for battlefield intimidation. While lacking the advanced modularity of an OmniMech, the Smilodon is built for sustained frontline engagement. It uses Ferro-Silk armor, a lightweight, steel-polymer lattice developed by Northern Meshworks, trading some durability for weight savings to support heavier weapons in line with the Tribe’s focus on overwhelming offensive capability. The Smilodon stands as a testament to the Tribe’s doctrine of overwhelming force and their refusal to abandon classic battle-tested principles.
column2: Smilodon 是明尼苏达部落部署的 110 吨线列战斗机甲，由 Independence Weaponry 生产，是可靠的前线格斗者。它以史前剑齿掠食者命名，象征着部落武术传统所重视的残酷效率和捕食者般的专注。设计灵感来自 Ebon Jaguar，拥有低伏、前倾的姿态和适合震慑敌人的凶悍外形。它没有全能机甲的先进模块化能力，却为持续前线作战而生。Smilodon 使用 Northern Meshworks 开发的轻型钢聚合物晶格 Ferro-Silk 装甲，以部分耐久性换取减重，从而安装更重武器，贯彻部落压倒性进攻理念。它证明了部落坚持经典实战原则、追求压倒性力量的信条。

column1: Produced by Leopard Armor for the Word of Blake, the Red Shift is one of many new BattleMechs being fielded by the Word of Blake Militia. The Red Shift is designed to spot for the Padilla artillery tank, which is also built by Leopard Armor, with its TAG target designator. The Red Shift is built on a lightweight Leopard Mark I Endo Steel chassis and is powered by a GM 180 XL engine that pushes the 'Mech's top speed up to 151.2 km/h. To give the 'Mech the ability to protect itself from advanced electronic warfare systems, the Red Shift has a Guardian ECM Suite. For protection from conventional weapons, the Red Shift has four tons of 1/Star Slab Ferro-Fibrous armor. To dissipate the 'Mech's scant waste heat, the Red Shift is outfitted with ten heat sinks. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Red Shift 由 Leopard Armor 为 Blake 之言生产，是 Blake 之言民兵正在装备的新型战斗机甲之一。它配备 TAG 目标指示器，为同厂生产的 Padilla 火炮坦克提供标定。Red Shift 采用轻型 Leopard Mark I 内骨骼底盘，由 GM 180 XL 引擎驱动，最高速度可达 151.2 公里/小时。为了抵御先进电子战系统，它安装 Guardian ECM 套件；为了防护常规武器，它配备 4 吨 1/Star Slab 铁纤维装甲。十个散热器足以处理这台机甲不多的废热。 特性：改进通信 部署费用倍率：0.97 手臂执行器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: Developed as a Fast Recon and Assault unit, the Trialist is a relatively new light tank exclusively fielded by Clan Hells Horses. Powered by a 65 rated Fusion Engine and armoured in 4 tons of Ferro-Fibrous, the Trialist is a cheap and effective combatant. Currently 3 variants exist: the standard ER Medium Laser/SRM combo, an ERML/LRM combo and a spotter model with a combination of Light Probe/Light TAG/ECM and the ERMLs.Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 10/15 hexes / 300/450 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous (C) Structure: Structure Values A S Front 125 10 Left 100 10 Right 100 10 Rear 75 10 Total 400 40 Quirk: Slippery Customer
column2: Trialist 是一种相对新型的轻型坦克，作为快速侦察与突击单位专供地狱之马氏族使用。它由 65 级聚变引擎驱动，披覆 4 吨铁纤维装甲，廉价而高效。目前有三种变体：标准 ER 中型激光/SRM 组合、ERML/LRM 组合，以及配备轻型探测器、轻型 TAG、ECM 和 ERML 的标定型号。经 Aries Games and Miniatures 授权使用。 生物群系限制：无。 移动力：10/15 格 / 300/450 米。 装甲：铁纤维（氏族） 结构：结构 数值 前 后 前方 125 10 左侧 100 10 右侧 100 10 后方 75 10 总计 400 40 特性：滑头客户

column1: The Schildkröte Line Tank is a Medium sized Combat Vehicle, originally designed for the Lyran Commonwealth's armed forces in 3122. A durable but slow tank, the Schildkröte was not well regarded when it first premiered. Due to this perception of it being too slow for frontline units, the vehicle was distributed among the Commonwealth's lower tier combat formations and planetary militia. However, over time the tank's durability would win over many with its performance in the field. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. Armor: Heavy Ferro-Fibrous Structure: Structure Values A S Front 245 25 Left 200 25 Right 200 25 Rear 200 25 Turret 160 25 Total 1005 125 Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long
column2: Schildkröte 线列坦克是一种中型战斗载具，最初于 3122 年为莱拉联邦武装部队设计。它坚固却迟缓，刚问世时评价不高。由于被认为不适合前线部队，这台坦克被分配给联邦的低级战斗编队和行星民兵。但随着时间推移，它在战场上的耐久表现逐渐赢得认可。 生物群系限制：无。 移动力：3/5 格 / 90/150 米。 装甲：重型铁纤维 结构：结构 数值 前 后 前方 245 25 左侧 200 25 右侧 200 25 后方 200 25 炮塔 160 25 总计 1005 125 特性：改进型瞄准 - 长程

column1: Created to tap into the burgeoning market for combat vehicles in the post Blackout Inner Sphere, the 30 ton Onuris is an Omni adaption of the Anhur Assault Transport. Developed and sold by the Sea Foxes, the Onuris is covered powered by a 100-rated XL Engine augmented by a Jet Booster, giving it a top speed in excess of 160 km/h. 6 tons of Reflective armor and Clan standard CASE provide protection whilst a massive 14 tons of pod space allows for a wide variety of configurations. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 8/12 hexes / 240/360 meters. Armor: Glazed (C) Structure: Structure Values A S Front 180 15 Left 120 15 Right 120 15 Rear 100 15 Total 535 75 Quirk: Quick Off The Line Omni Vehicle
column2: 为了进入黑障后的内天体战斗载具市场，海狐氏族开发了 30 吨的 Onuris，它是 Anhur 强袭运输车的全能改型。Onuris 由海狐生产销售，配备 100 级 XL 引擎和喷气助推器，最高速度超过 160 公里/小时。6 吨反射装甲和氏族标准 CASE 提供防护，14 吨挂载舱则允许多种配置。 生物群系限制：无法部署于月面生物群系。 移动力：8/12 格 / 240/360 米。 装甲：镀层（氏族） 结构：结构 数值 前 后 前方 180 15 左侧 120 15 右侧 120 15 后方 100 15 总计 535 75 特性：快速起步 全能载具

column1: One of Clan Coyotes contributions to the Homeworld Clans, the Telippa is a fast and well armoured heavy tank. A 75 ton wheeled Omni-Tank, the Telippa is powered by a 355 XXL and clad in 18 tons of Ferro Lamellor armour; giving it 27 tons of podspace. Known variants include: An ER PPC/iATM-12 combo augmented by an Angel ECM suit and 4 Machine Guns, a HAG/20 paired with 3 ER Medium Lasers and an iATM-9; and 2 iATM-12s mated to an ER Large Laser and an Angel ECM suit.Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 5/8 hexes / 150/240 meters. Armor: Ferro-Lamellor (C) Structure: Endo-Steel (C) Values A S Front 360 40 Left 285 40 Right 285 40 Rear 225 40 Turret 285 40 Total 1440 200 Quirk: Main Battle Tank
column2: Telippa 是郊狼氏族献给母星氏族的设计之一，是一台速度快、装甲厚的重型坦克。这台 75 吨轮式全能坦克由 355 XXL 引擎驱动，披覆 18 吨 Ferro Lamellor 装甲，并拥有 27 吨挂载舱。已知变体包括：ER PPC/iATM-12 组合，配 Angel ECM 套件和 4 挺机枪；HAG/20 配 3 门 ER 中型激光和 iATM-9；以及 2 门 iATM-12 配 ER 大型激光和 Angel ECM 套件。经 Aries Games and Miniatures 授权使用。 生物群系限制：无。 移动力：5/8 格 / 150/240 米。 装甲：Ferro-Lamellor（氏族） 结构：内骨骼（氏族） 数值 前 后 前方 360 40 左侧 285 40 右侧 285 40 后方 225 40 炮塔 285 40 总计 1440 200 特性：主战坦克

column1: The Skadi is a Fast Attack VTOL. It can reach a top speed of 162 km/h, and is protected by four and a half tons of Clan-spec Ferro-Fibrous Armor. The Skadi was originally designed by Clan Jade Falcon, but the main factory fell to the Lyran Commonwealth. For the next few decades, the Commonwealth sold the Skadi to any interested party. The combination of good protection, high speed, and a heavy gun proved to be very popular, and the Skadi was exported across the Inner Sphere. The Falcons later recaptured the facility and have restricted the Skadi to their own forces. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 10/15 hexes / 300/450 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous (C) Structure: Structure Values A S Front 125 18 Left 100 18 Right 100 18 Rear 90 18 Turret 15 18 Total 430 90 Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Ballistics
column2: Skadi 是一台快速攻击型垂直起降机，最高速度可达 162 公里/小时，并由 4.5 吨氏族级铁纤维装甲保护。它最初由玉衡鹰氏族设计，但主工厂后来落入莱拉联邦手中。接下来的几十年里，联邦向所有有兴趣的势力出售 Skadi。良好的防护、高速和重炮组合广受欢迎，Skadi 一度出口到整个内天体。后来玉衡鹰夺回工厂，并将 Skadi 限制为自用。 生物群系限制：无法部署于月面生物群系。 移动力：10/15 格 / 300/450 米。 装甲：铁纤维（氏族） 结构：结构 数值 前 后 前方 125 18 左侧 100 18 右侧 100 18 后方 90 18 炮塔 15 18 总计 430 90 特性：精准武器 - 弹道

column1: Party!
column2: 聚会！

column1: Tribe Command Juggernaut
column2: 部落指挥主宰

column1: Shows their vision when lance mates move
column2: 展现他们在长枪队友移动时的视野

column1: Critical Components protection increased by 20%.
column2: 关键部件防护提高 20%。

column1: Privacy for a mechwarrior outside the cockpit is rare.
column2: 机甲战士离开驾驶舱后还能拥有隐私，是很少见的事。

column1: This pilot has a broken leg and is suffering a Piloting Skill penalty.
column2: 这名驾驶员腿部骨折，受到驾驶技能惩罚。

column1: A BattleMech sized sword inflicting a lot of damage but generates heat.
column2: 一把机甲战士尺寸的巨剑，能造成大量伤害，但会产生热量。

column1: The 'Badb Catha' (Battle Crow) was named for old terran irish folklore after a Goddess of Death and Chaos, foreshadowing imminent Bloodshed and sowing confusion.
column2: Badb Catha（战鸦）以古老的 Terra 爱尔兰民间传说中的死亡与混沌女神命名，预示着即将到来的血腥冲突与混乱。

column1: This one's a copycat, built by the Lyrans just to prove they could match the Hunchback, but lighter at 45 tons thanks to endo steel and double heat sinks. Stayed exclusive to the Commonwealth its whole life.
column2: 这是莱拉人为了证明自己能与 Hunchback 匹敌而造的仿制品。它采用内骨骼和双重散热器，重量减轻到 45 吨，并在整个服役期内始终只供莱拉联邦使用。

column1: The Doom Courser is a 70 ton Quad OmniMech introduced by Clan Hell's Horses in an attempt to improve the performance of their QuadVee and improve the carrying capability of Elementals into battle by their forces.
column2: Doom Courser 是一台 70 吨四足全能机甲，由地狱之马氏族推出，旨在提升 QuadVee 的性能，并提高部队将元素战士运入战场的能力。

column1: Virtually a self-contained emergency Coolant Truck, the Coolant Pod contains a reserve of compressed freon which can be flushed directly into the attached 'Mech's coolant system. VOLATILE!
column2: Coolant Pod 几乎就是一辆自带完整系统的应急冷却车，内含压缩氟利昂储备，可以直接冲入相连机甲的冷却系统。易爆！

column1: Micro Missiles are an Advanced Guided Warhead. Upon receiving a Critical Hit, any remaining ammunition stored inside an Ammo Bin will explode, dealing damage to the install location. Risk can be mitigated with the use of C.A.S.E.
column2: 微型导弹是一种先进制导弹头。受到暴击后，弹药箱中剩余的弹药会爆炸，对安装部位造成伤害。使用 C.A.S.E. 可以降低风险。

column1: The Rook is a capable if unspectacular BattleMech. The original version uses RetroTech components to build a cheap but reliable BattleMech. Later versions improved the design with modern technologies, raising its standards even further.
column2: Rook 是一台能力全面却并不出彩的战斗机甲。原版使用复古科技部件，打造出廉价可靠的战斗机甲；后续型号加入现代技术，进一步提升了性能标准。

column1: The Warlord was originally intended as a streamlined, all-energy weapon variation of the classic BLR-1G BattleMaster, but the changes and weight reduction were significant enough that GM's intellectual property lawyers insisted on a new name.
column2: Warlord 最初计划作为经典 BLR-1G BattleMaster 的流线型全能量武器变体，但改动和减重幅度太大，迫使 GM 的知识产权律师坚持要求更换名称。

column1: Boss, I know it looks like some AeroTechs decided they wanted a Crab to fly but I promise you, this thing is more than just a bigger Crab. The extra ten tons of ‘Mech really make this thing sing, it’s fast enough to get you in trouble and durable enough to get you back out.
column2: 老板，我知道它看起来像是某些 AeroTech 想让一只 Crab 飞起来，但我保证，这东西不只是更大的 Crab。多出来的十吨机体让它真正活了起来：速度快到足以把你带进麻烦，也足够结实，能把你带出来。

column1: You nod at Darius. "We're not a charity, but we can spare some of our medical supplies. Reach out and see if they're willing to pay."\n\nDarius gives Dr. Murad a pointed look, but they both keep any further thoughts to themselves and the daily briefing moves onto other topics.
column2: 你向达利乌斯点头：“我们不是慈善机构，但可以分出一些医疗物资。去联系一下，看看他们愿不愿意付钱。”\n\n达利乌斯意味深长地看了穆拉德博士一眼，但两人没有再说什么，日常简报转向了其他话题。

column1: Requiring a more advanced and enduring Command Unit, designers have revisited the original Black Knight Specs. Taking cues from the Harjel system of Battle Armor, and advances from Clan Diamond Shark, this mech is outfitted with a specialized diagnostics and self repair system.
column2: 由于需要更先进、更耐用的指挥单元，设计师重新审视了最初的 Black Knight 规格。他们借鉴战斗装甲的 Harjel 系统以及钻石鲨氏族的技术进步，为这台机甲配备了专用诊断与自我修复系统。

column1: The Goshawk II is a Medium BattleMech built by Clan Snow Raven in the mid-3080s. Based on the heavier Vapor Eagle (also known as the Goshawk), it is produced on the Inner Sphere world of Dante. The Goshawk II was designed as a second-line BattleMech for use exclusively by the Ravens.
column2: Goshawk II 是雪鸦氏族在 3080 年代中期制造的中型战斗机甲。它以更重的 Vapor Eagle（也称 Goshawk）为基础，在内天体的 Dante 星生产，专供雪鸦作为二线战斗机甲使用。

column1: Virtually a self-contained emergency Coolant Truck, the Coolant Pod contains a reserve of compressed freon which can be flushed directly into the attached 'Mechs coolant system. Coolant pods are highly susceptible to weapons fire and explode if struck. VOLATILE!
column2: Coolant Pod 几乎就是一辆自带完整系统的应急冷却车，内含压缩氟利昂储备，可以直接冲入相连机甲的冷却系统。冷却舱极易受到武器火力影响，被击中后会爆炸。易爆！

column1: Darius grumbles to you as the port authorities depart the ship. "Those fees look a lot like state-sanctioned bribes to me."\n\nYang flips through the paperwork they left behind and holds up a coupon card for the local entertainment district. "Now, that's the forces of law and order for you."
column2: 港口当局离舰后，达利乌斯对你抱怨道：“这些费用看起来很像政府批准的行贿。”\n\nYang 翻着他们留下的文件，举起一张当地娱乐区的优惠券：“这就是所谓的执法与秩序。”

column1: A rare sight boss! This is a light scout OmniVehicle pretty much exclusively made by Clan Hell's Horses. It was designed to comfortably fit infantry in that bay there but I reckon we could squeeze a full squad of battle armor in there in a pinch, they probably won't be happy about it though.
column2: 少见的景象，老板！这是一台几乎只由地狱之马氏族制造的轻型侦察全能载具。它原本设计成能舒适地容纳步兵，但我想，真有必要的话，我们也能硬塞进一整班战斗装甲——他们大概不会喜欢。

column1: Many MechWarriors assigned a Rime Otter have outright demanded Sea Fox-built powerhouses like a Mad Dog Mk IV or a WarBear-designed Stormwolf instead. On the other hand, some pilots believe a warrior should work for a kill rather than simply overwhelm foes with firepower. I am one of the latter.
column2: 许多被分配驾驶 Rime Otter 的机甲战士，曾明确要求换成海狐制造的 Mad Dog Mk IV，或 WarBear 设计的 Stormwolf 之类的强机。另一方面，也有些驾驶员认为，战士应该靠自己赢得击杀，而不是单纯用火力压倒敌人。我属于后者。

column1: Take a basic Jagermech, make it even bigger, and you have Independence Weaponry's Uberjager. A 115 ton beast of raw ballistic damage, it is entirely focused on autocannons and their auxiliary systems. In an attempt to keep costs down, the Uberjager only mounts a 285 XL engine and has limited armor.
column2: 把一台普通 Jagermech 再放大一些，你得到的就是 Independence Weaponry 的 Uberjager。这是一头 115 吨的纯弹道伤害巨兽，完全围绕自动炮及其辅助系统打造。为压低成本，Uberjager 只安装 285 级 XL 引擎，装甲也相当有限。

column1: In a bid to join the Arms Race of Inner Sphere OmniMech Designs have Hellespont reacted with an attempt to upgrade their most iconic salespiece, The UrbanMech. Dubbed the 'Mobile Turret' does it do what every 'Urbie' ever did, sadly the upgraded cost and expertise required for Maintenance, left it mostly unsold.
column2: 为了加入内天体全能机甲的军备竞赛，Hellespont 试图升级其最著名的畅销品 UrbanMech。这台被称为“移动炮塔”的机甲，确实完成了每一台 Urbie 都会做的事；可惜升级后的成本和维护所需专业技术太高，导致它几乎卖不出去。

column1: The Bushranger is a Forestry and Surveyal 'Mech designed by the Star League to be deployed on planets still being 'tamed', the only design to receive unique reinforced structure and myomer more similar to Mech's far above its weight class is it not only sturdy, but able to carry large amounts of weight with ease.
column2: Bushranger 是星盟设计的森林与测绘机甲，用于部署到仍在“驯服”中的星球。它是唯一采用独特强化结构和肌肉、性能更接近高吨位机甲的设计；它不仅坚固，还能轻松携带大量重量。

column1: The Ebony is a light BattleMech produced jointly by the Magistracy of Canopus and the Capellan Confederation. This stealthy BattleMech first appeared in 3081, and was reportedly being built in factories on Canopus IV and Sian. The 'Mech is allegedly named for the Magistracy's secret intelligence branch, the Ebon Magistrate.
column2: Ebony 是金星都督府与卡佩兰联邦联合生产的轻型战斗机甲。这台隐形战斗机甲于 3081 年首次出现，据称在金星都督府第四行星和 Sian 的工厂生产。传闻它以都督府秘密情报部门 Ebon Magistrate 命名。

column1: The Gùn is a moderately fast light OmniMech which was designed by the Capellan Confederation as an Infantry Support 'Mech. Designed with 10 tons of pod space, the default configuration of the Gùn features a combination of anti-infantry and anti-vehicle energy weaponry. The 'Mech also features a Small Cockpit and an XL Gyro.
column2: Gùn 是一台速度适中的轻型全能机甲，由卡佩兰联邦设计，作为步兵支援机甲使用。它拥有 10 吨挂载舱，默认配置结合反步兵与反载具能量武器；同时配备小型驾驶舱和 XL 陀螺仪。

column1: After an hour of somewhat indifferent searching by the customs crew, their officer approaches you, clipboard in hand. You can see mostly green check marks on the list.\n\nHe gives a click of his heels and a polite nod. "Commander, you run a tight ship here. I'm prepared to let you enter the port. Thank-you for your cooperation."
column2: 海关人员漫不经心地搜查了一个小时后，他们的官员拿着夹板走向你。你看到清单上大多是绿色勾选。\n\n他脚跟一并，礼貌地点头：“指挥官，你把船管得很严。我准备放你们进入港口。感谢配合。”

column1: Created at an undisclosed factory by taking a King Crab and increasing it to 150 tons, the Exarch Crab is a ComStar creation to trials its latest acquire weapon - the Plasma Railgun. The 'Mech has been reported to be seen throughout the Inner Sphere, so the assumption is that ComStar have spread it for further trialing purposes.
column2: Exarch Crab 在一座未公开的工厂里由 King Crab 增重改造至 150 吨，是 ComStar 用来试验最新武器——等离子轨道炮的作品。据报道，它已经出现在内天体各处，因此人们推测 ComStar 正将它分散部署以继续测试。

column1: Achernar built this when the AFFS needed something they could actually manufacture with what they had left after the Succession Wars. The LN-15 ended up being a big export seller to the Free Worlds League and the Magistracy. Finding any of these variants is reasonably straightforward compared to some of what comes through the bay.
column2: 当 AFFS 需要一种能用继承战争后残余资源实际生产的机甲时，Achernar 造出了它。LN-15 最终成为自由世界联盟和金星都督府的大卖出口型号。与那些偶尔出现在机甲库里的稀有型号相比，这些变体相当容易找到。

column1: The Headsman is one of the largest 'Mechs made by the clans. A 190 ton OmniMech with a 450 XXL engine, Ferro-Carbide Lamellor Armor and advanced piloting, firing and EWS systems, it is not a 'Mech you want to see in the opposing forces. It's major downside is it very high cost, making acquiring, fielding and repairing it a huge cost.
column2: Headsman 是氏族制造的最大型机甲之一。这台 190 吨全能机甲装备 450 XXL 引擎、Ferro-Carbide Lamellor 装甲以及先进的驾驶、火控和电子战系统，没人愿意在敌方阵线看到它。它最大的缺点是价格极高，获取、部署和维修都要付出巨大代价。

column1: The Crimson HellKite was the result of a secret project by several design teams within the Clans to create the best medium 'Mech possible. The goal was never met, as the result 'Mech was just another standard 55 tonner Omni, its only benefit being its ease to repair due to using only stock components available from other common 'Mechs..
column2: Crimson HellKite 源于氏族内部多个设计团队的秘密项目，目标是打造最优秀的中型机甲。目标最终没有实现，成品只是另一台标准的 55 吨全能机甲，唯一优势是只使用其他常见机甲都能找到的库存部件，维修十分方便。

column1: The Fenrir II Assault Battle Armor may have allegedly originated as the result of a bet between Archon Adam Steiner and Duke Vedet Brewer of Hesperus II, but Duke Brewer's vision of "a monstrous wolf straight from the nightmares of our ancestors" proved to be one of the most popular battle suits on the market after its introduction to service in 3119.
column2: Fenrir II 强袭战斗装甲据称可能源自 Archon Adam Steiner 与 Hesperus II 公爵 Vedet Brewer 的一次赌局，但 Brewer 公爵所构想的“从祖先噩梦中走出的怪狼”，在 3119 年投入服役后，竟成为市场上最受欢迎的战斗装甲之一。

column1:
You nod at Darius. "We're not a charity, but we can spare some of our medical supplies. Reach out and see if they're willing to pay."

Darius gives Dr. Murad a pointed look, but they both keep any further thoughts to themselves.

Over the next several days, word trickles through the ship about your decision, leading to heated arguments on both side.
column2:
你向达利乌斯点头：“我们不是慈善机构，但可以分出一些医疗物资。去联系一下，看看他们愿不愿意付钱。”

达利乌斯意味深长地看了穆拉德博士一眼，但两人没有再说什么。

接下来的几天，你的决定在舰内逐渐传开，双方因此争论不休。

column1: Built on the design of the Shrike, the Caracara is Clan Jade Falcons first foray into Superheavies. Packing a variation of advanced equipment for command, EWS and weapons targeting, the design is clearly aimed towards the Star Commanders of the Clan. The Caracara further keeps the jump capabilities of the Shrike by use of two Booster Jets and a Partial Wing System.
column2: Caracara 以 Shrike 为基础，是玉衡鹰氏族首次进军超重型机甲的尝试。它搭载多种先进的指挥、电子战和武器瞄准设备，显然是为氏族星指挥官打造的。Caracara 还通过两台助推喷气机和部分机翼系统保留了 Shrike 的跳跃能力。

column1: The Revenant was originally a Word of Blake light drone 'Mech. The Revenant was primarily intended to engage light armor and infantry, a role that its weapon mix favored, but its ability to do so was hampered by a combination of mobility and armor more common to Succession Wars-era scout 'Mechs than the more advanced designs commonplace in the late thirty-first century.
column2: Revenant 最初是 Blake 之言的轻型无人机甲，主要用于对付轻型装甲和步兵，武器组合也偏向这一任务。但它的机动性和装甲更接近继承战争时期的侦察机甲，而不是 31 世纪末常见的先进设计，因此实际作战能力受到限制。

column1: A very recent design from Jötunn BattleWorx, they bring together a lot of the recently learned clan technologies to create a powerful OmniMech. Thanks to its durability Mastodon MechWarriors often exaggerate signs of damage, prompting foes to overcommit in attempts to down them. Coordination with quicker units usually results in an enveloped and defeated opponent—and a still-functioning Mastodon.
column2: 这是 Jötunn BattleWorx 非常新的设计，将近期掌握的多项氏族技术结合起来，打造出强大的全能机甲。由于耐久性出色，Mastodon 的驾驶员常常故意夸大受损迹象，引诱敌人投入过多力量试图击毁它。只要与更快的单位协同，通常就能包围并击败对手，而 Mastodon 仍会继续运转。

column1: The Clan Battle Armor is based on the Elemental suit, its visual aesthetic that shows that the Clan's contact with the Draconis Combine was already rubbing off on them. Though the design has a slow ground speed, the designers used the jump booster pioneered on the Gray Death Scout armor to rocket it up to one hundred twenty meters at a time. This necessitated a slight reduction in armor and a reworking of the weaponry.
column2: 氏族战斗装甲以元素战士装甲为基础，其外观显示出氏族与龙辰联邦的接触已经开始影响他们。虽然这套设计地面速度较慢，但设计师采用了源自 Gray Death 侦察装甲的跳跃助推器，使它一次可跃升 120 米。因此它不得不略微减少装甲，并重新设计武器配置。

column1: The Tau is Clan Stone Lion’s fast, hard-hitting replacement for medium-class OmniMechs, developed from captured Ice Ferret chassis after the Wars of Reaving. Named after the Tswana word for lion, the Tau boasts a base speed of 127 kph, with some variants hitting 165 kph using a supercharger. Its Ferro-Lamellor armor, provided via Star Adder specs, offers enhanced protection, making the Tau a difficult and resilient target in combat.
column2: 陶是石狮氏族为替代中型全能机甲而开发的高速重击型机体，源自掠夺战争后缴获的冰鼬底盘。其名称取自茨瓦纳语中的“狮子”，基础速度达到 127 公里/小时，部分变型机配备增压器后可达到 165 公里/小时。由星蝰蛇规格提供的铁素体层压装甲带来更强防护，使陶在战斗中成为难以击破且十分坚韧的目标。

column1: This thing dates back to 2501, which means it was already ancient when the Star League collapsed. New Earth Trading Company built it, Earthwerks kept producing it, and somehow examples survived all the way to now. The jump jets on an assault mech that size were a big deal when it was new and honestly they still are. Getting one of these out of salvage is finding a piece of history that can still punch a hole through most of what it faces.
column2: 这东西可以追溯到 2501 年，也就是说，星盟崩溃时它就已经是古董了。新地球贸易公司建造了它，地球工坊一直负责生产，不知怎么的，居然还有样机一路留存到了今天。这么大的突击机甲上安装的跳跃喷射器，在它刚问世时可是不得了的配置，说实话现在依然如此。能从打捞物中找到一台这样的机体，就等于发现了一段仍能在战场上给大多数对手开个洞的历史。

column1:
You lay out the plan. "Send the lead inspectors to meet in my office while their people conduct the search."

Sumire grins. "Individuals are always easier to bribe than institutions."

Hours later, after a little smooth talking, a refreshing drink, a glance at a compad, and a small crate waiting at the airlock, Darius looks over the results of the inspection. "All green check marks as far as the eye can see. Ah, the forces of law and order."
column2:
你说明了计划。“让首席检查员到我的办公室来会面，同时让他们的人进行搜查。”

隅里咧嘴一笑。“个人总是比机构更容易收买。”

几小时后，经过一番圆滑周旋、一杯提神饮料、扫过一眼数据板，以及气闸舱旁等着的一只小箱子，大流士查看着检查结果。“视线所及全是绿色勾选。啊，这就是法律与秩序的力量。”

column1: The Black Mamba OmniMech is produced at three known facilities: on Strana Mechty by the Star Adders, on Huntress by the Cloud Cobras, and a rumored factory in the Deep Periphery near the invasion corridor. This OmniMech combines durability with agility, able to absorb significant damage while delivering powerful counterattacks. Despite its size, it remains remarkably nimble on the battlefield, making it a versatile and formidable asset in combat.
column2: 黑曼巴全能机甲目前已知在三处设施生产：星蝰蛇在斯特拉纳梅赫提负责生产，云蛇在女猎手负责生产，入侵走廊附近的深层边疆据说还有一座工厂。这款全能机甲兼具耐久与敏捷，能够承受大量损伤并发动强力反击。尽管体型庞大，它在战场上仍异常灵活，是一种用途广泛且令人畏惧的战斗资产。

column1: A pirate band found one of these drifting in a misjumped dropship, not a soul left alive aboard, just skeletal remains and a strange 'Mech in the cargo bay. Nothing about it matched Star League records they knew. Named it after that old Terran tale on account of the mongoose painted on the shoulder. Sold it to King Grimm for fifty million C-Bills, though it never made it to Oberon. Mysterious white fighters tore the whole convoy apart before they got there.
column2: 一支海盗团在一艘因跳跃失误而漂流的运输船上发现了它：船上没有一个活人，只剩骨骸，以及货舱里一台奇怪的机甲。他们掌握的星盟记录中没有任何与之相符的资料。由于肩部涂着一只猫鼬，他们便以那部古老的泰拉故事为它命名。他们以五千万 C-Bills 的价格卖给了格林王，但它没能抵达欧贝隆。几架神秘的白色战斗机在他们到达之前就把整支车队撕得粉碎。

column1: The Morrigan is a light BattleMech that was developed by Clan Nova Cat just after the Jihad to meet their need for a new scout 'Mech. The Nova Cats received technical and material support from the Draconis Combine who had access to the design as well. Political wrangling among the Nova Cats and Draconis Combine kept the overall production numbers low however. The design was deployed as part of the Nova Cat's second line troops, and the Combine sent Morrigans to their elite units.
column2: 莫里根是一种轻型战斗机甲，由新星猫氏族在圣战结束后不久开发，用来满足他们对新型侦察机甲的需求。新星猫氏族得到了龙蛇合众国的技术与物资支持，而后者也能接触到这一设计。然而，新星猫氏族与龙蛇合众国之间的政治角力使总产量一直很低。这一设计被部署到新星猫氏族的二线部队中，合众国则将莫里根派给了自己的精锐单位。

column1: Before you even say it, no, the rocket-assisted combining thing detailed in the cockpit does not work. I have no idea why they though that would, but carrying around so much fuel and transformation mechanisms just makes for a very crappy LAM. Oh crap... NO! We're not going to make one of these from Urbie LAMs, it wouldn't even work like that! Just be happy it's the massive Urbie of your dreams and will freak out most green troops. Heck, it even has some fancy Clan armor and weaponry!
column2: 在你开口之前先说好：不，驾驶舱里写的火箭助推合体机构根本不能用。我完全不知道他们当时为什么会觉得这东西能行，但带着那么多燃料和变形机构，只会造出一台糟糕透顶的 LAM。哦，糟了……不！我们不会拿城市机甲 LAM 改出这种东西，那样根本行不通！你就知足吧，它已经是你梦想中的巨型城市机甲，足以把大多数新兵吓得魂不附体。见鬼，它甚至还装着一些花哨的氏族装甲和武器！

column1: The Pantaleon is a Stone Lion Assault OmniMech designed with help from Clan Star Adder. Named from the ancient Terran Greek word for "all lion," it features a chassis and Ferro-Lamellor armor based on Star Adder specs, with other updated components. Manufactured at Tokasha MechWorks and a Deep Periphery facility, it includes a supercharger for bursts up to 87 kph, optional targeting computers for improved accuracy, and heavy armor, making it a durable and deadly unit on the battlefield.
column2: 潘塔勒翁是石狮氏族的突击型全能机甲，在星蝰蛇氏族的协助下设计。它的名称源自古泰拉希腊语，意为“全狮”，底盘与铁素体层压装甲以星蝰蛇规格为基础，并配备了其他升级部件。该机体在托卡沙机工厂和一处深层边疆设施生产，配有增压器，短时间内可达 87 公里/小时；可选的瞄准计算机能够提升精度，再加上厚重装甲，使它成为战场上耐打而致命的单位。

column1: The Shedu is a battle armor design in the Word of Blake's Demon Series that is used exclusively by Manei Domini, one of the last of the Demons to be created by Precentor Vapula. Named for the half-bull, half-human demons of myth, the Shedu is an assault-class, quadrupedal battlesuit, a radical departure from the rest of the Demon line. The major advantage of the quad chassis is its speed, and Vapula used that to give the Shedu an excellent maximum ground speed for an assault-weight suit.
column2: 舍杜是布莱克之词恶魔系列中的一种战斗装甲设计，仅由玛涅伊·多米尼使用，也是瓦普拉首席牧师制造的最后几种恶魔之一。它以神话中半牛半人的恶魔命名，是一种突击级四足战斗服，与恶魔系列的其他成员截然不同。四足底盘的主要优势在于速度，瓦普拉正是利用这一点，让舍杜这种突击重量级战斗服拥有出色的最大地面速度。

column1: Considered a by-gone design by the time of the Reunification Wars, the Icarus II rarely crossed paths with the Star League Defense Force and was not even much of an afterthought after the Exodus to Clan Space. This fairly unremarkable history made the shock of the Icarus IIC's appearance that much more shocking. This Omni-Mech redesign was proposed to both Jade Falcon and Steel Viper leadership who rejected it outright. However, the design survived and evolved thanks to a few Society cells.
column2: 到统一战争时期，伊卡洛斯 II 已被视为过时设计，很少与星盟防卫军交锋；大迁徙前往氏族空间后，它甚至没留下多少值得一提的余波。正因历史如此平淡，伊卡洛斯 IIC 的现身才显得格外震撼。这种全能机甲改型曾同时提交给翡翠隼与钢蝰蛇的高层，却被他们断然拒绝。然而，凭借少数社会组织细胞的努力，这一设计仍得以保存并继续演化。

column1: Designed in the middle of the thirty-second century, the Wendigo is a Medium Class OmniMech designed and produced originally for Clan Nova Cat. The 'Mech's creation stems from the results of the Clan's prolonged efforts with Draconis Combine's Luthien Armor Works to produce a replacement design for its touman. The resulting Avalanche turned out to be less than what the Clan had hoped for, so using the basic premise of the Avalanche design, the results of Clan Scientists would become the Wendigo.
column2: 温迪戈设计于三十二世纪中叶，是最初为新星猫氏族设计并生产的中型全能机甲。这台机甲的诞生源于该氏族与龙蛇合众国卢森装甲厂长期合作、试图为其图曼部队制造替代设计的成果。最终的雪崩未能达到氏族预期，于是氏族科学家以雪崩设计的基本理念为基础，研发出了温迪戈。

column1: The Malice appears to be on its way towards becoming one of the premier mercenary assault 'Mechs of the age. Seen most often in the Galatean Defense Force and the Republic Armed Forces, the Malice has seen a lot of action for such a recent addition to the battlefield. Very fast for an assault 'Mech, topping out around 64 km/h, this brute can bring a withering barrage of autocannon fire to bear. Protected by more than nineteen tons of standard armor, the Malice can remain in combat for a long time.
column2: 恶意机甲似乎正逐渐成为这个时代最顶尖的雇佣兵突击机甲之一。它最常见于加拉泰防卫军和共和国武装部队，作为刚加入战场不久的设计，却已经经历了大量战斗。对于一台突击机甲而言，它的速度极快，最高时速约 64 公里；这头蛮兽能够倾泻出令人窒息的自动火炮弹幕。凭借超过十九吨的标准装甲，恶意机甲可以长时间留在战场上作战。

column1: The Mingan, named for the Gray Wolf, is a heavy-hitting light OmniMech replacing the aging Adder. Built alongside the Wulfen and Warwolf, it shares a similar wolf-like design and components, simplifying repairs and logistics. Deployed heavily by the Wolf Empire, the Mingan excels in versatility—switching between close combat and long-range fire support. Its Laser-Reflective armor offers strong defense against energy weapons, making it a prized and adaptive unit in the Republic of the Sphere assault.
column2: 明甘以灰狼命名，是一台火力强大的轻型全能机甲，用来替代日渐老旧的阿达。它与乌尔芬和战狼一同建造，共享相似的狼形设计与部件，从而简化维修和后勤。明甘被狼帝国大量部署，拥有出色的多用途能力，可在近距离战斗与远程火力支援之间切换。其激光反射装甲能有效抵御能量武器，使它成为球体共和国攻势中备受珍视且适应力极强的单位。

column1: So look Commander, this thing is a gigantic beast but it's really an IndustrialMech SLDF Prototype made for working on DropShips that is over 300 years old. I am not sure how _these_ fraggers have kept the thing running for 300 years, but I'm pretty sure one of the arms is like 6 legs of various UrbanMechs welded together. The ''armor'' is just the chest pieces of what has to be dozens of other mechs welded onto this freakshow. I have no idea why but the locals have been using it to build barns. For cows.
column2: 听我说，指挥官，这东西看起来是头巨兽，但实际上是一台三百多年前制造、用于维修运输船的星盟防卫军工业机甲原型。我真不知道这些混蛋是怎么让它运行三百年的，但我敢肯定，其中一条手臂就像是把六条不同城市机甲的腿焊在一起。所谓“装甲”，不过是把几十台其他机甲的胸甲焊到这场怪诞秀上。我也不知道为什么，当地人一直拿它来盖谷仓。给奶牛住的。

column1: Know who the most dangerous person in the world is? An Engineer, given a blank check to do whatever they want. Kim Aakawa, a relative to the Director of the Tonegawa Major shipyard, was scouted for such a project. The result? A bulked up DevastatUrb: the Urbiestator, a 200t mad dream of Urbies come to life. The shipyard has a constant demand for the Urbiestator from all over the Periphery, with each of the few handcrafted units produced each year being handed off in pompous ceremonies to the lucky recipients.
column2: 你知道世上最危险的人是谁吗？是一个拿到空白支票、可以随心所欲的工程师。金·赤川是户根川大型船厂厂长的亲属，正是这类项目把他招募了过去。结果呢？一台强化版的毁灭城市机甲：城市毁灭者，一场由城市机甲组成的 200 吨疯狂梦想成真。来自边疆各处的船厂对城市毁灭者需求不断，每年只生产寥寥几台手工打造的机体，并在盛大而傲慢的仪式上交给幸运的接收者。

column1: The Sköll is a fast, versatile medium OmniMech developed by the Wolf Empire to replace the Stormcrow. Built alongside the Tomahawk II, it shares components for easier repairs and logistics. Equipped with a Supercharger and Laser-Reflective armor, the Sköll excels in both speed and survivability. Its adaptable configurations suit various combat roles, making it a deadly frontline unit. Highly valued, no Sköll has been lost to isorla, underscoring its importance in the Empire’s push beyond the Fortress Republic.
column2: 斯库尔是一台由狼帝国开发、用于替代风暴乌鸦的高速多用途中型全能机甲。它与战斧 II 一同建造，共享部件以便维修和后勤。斯库尔配备增压器与激光反射装甲，在速度和生存能力方面都表现出色。其可调整的配置适合多种战斗职责，是一台致命的前线单位。它受到高度重视；没有任何一台斯库尔被当作伊斯欧拉战利品失去，这凸显了它在帝国越过堡垒共和国推进过程中的重要性。

column1: The Sagittaire is built to fight in the confines of an urban battlefield. Weighing in at a massive ninety-five tons, the Sagittaire started production in mid-3063 and began to trickle out to units clamoring for close combat 'Mechs in the midst of the FedCom Civil War. As a power source, the 'Mech has a 285 XL engine. The XL engine saves weight at the cost of survivability and gives the 'Mech a top speed of 54.0 km/h while its mobility is enhanced with three jump jets, allowing the 'Mech to jump up to ninety meters.
column2: 射手座专为城市战场的狭窄环境而造。这台重达九十五吨的机甲于 3063 年年中开始生产，在联邦-康姆内战期间，陆续交付给渴望近距离战斗机甲的部队。它以一台 285 型 XL 引擎为动力。XL 引擎牺牲生存能力来减轻重量，使机甲最高速度达到 54.0 公里/小时；三个跳跃喷射器进一步增强机动性，让它能够跃过九十米的距离。

column1:
You lay out the plan. "Send the lead inspectors to meet in my office while their people conduct the search."

Sumire grins. "Individuals are always easier to bribe than institutions."

Sometimes, however, they're stubborn, self-righteous prigs. After an embarrassing scene in your office, your company is fined for attempted bribery, as well as a minor infraction the inspectors spotted in your office.

Darius looks over the results of the inspection. "Red check marks all the way down. Some days you just can't win."
column2:
你说明了计划。“让首席检查员到我的办公室来会面，同时让他们的人进行搜查。”

隅里咧嘴一笑。“个人总是比机构更容易收买。”

然而，有时他们也会是顽固、自以为是的蠢货。在你的办公室闹出一场尴尬的乱子后，你的公司因企图行贿而被罚款，检查员还在办公室里发现了一项轻微违规。

大流士查看着检查结果。“一路都是红色勾选。有些日子，你就是怎么都赢不了。”

column1: Designed for fast recon and close-quarters combat, the Night Stalker is a medium BattleMech first produced during the mid-thirty-second century. The first original BattleMech produced by Victory Conditions Industries on Mizar, the Night Stalker was first unveiled in the arenas of Solaris VII, where it would gather a reputation that propelled the company’s sales to success. The design would soon see service with the Federated Suns, the Lyran Commonwealth, mercenary units, and among all the nation states of the Inner Sphere.
column2: 夜行者专为快速侦察和近距离战斗而设计，是一种在三十二世纪中叶首次生产的中型战斗机甲。它是胜利条件工业公司在米扎尔制造的第一款原创战斗机甲，最初在太阳神 VII 的竞技场亮相，并在那里积累了声誉，推动公司销售走向成功。很快，这一设计便开始在联邦太阳、莱阳联邦、雇佣兵部队以及内圈各国服役。

column1: The Tocho is a fast and agile Light OmniMech by Clan Stone Lion, named after the Hopi word for "mountain lion." Built alongside other models at Niles Industriplex Alpha, it shares components for easy maintenance. With only 6.5 tons of pod space, it’s lightly armed but hard to hit thanks to its extreme speed and built-in Supercharger. Though the Coyote Boyyi is faster, the Tocho remains formidable. 5.5 tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor max out its protection for its weight class, making it a nimble and resilient scout or skirmisher.
column2: 托乔是石狮氏族制造的高速敏捷轻型全能机甲，名称取自霍皮语中的“山狮”。它与其他型号一同在尼尔斯工业园 Alpha 建造，共享部件以便维护。它只有 6.5 吨的 Pod 空间，武装较轻，却凭借极端速度和内置增压器而难以命中。虽然郊狼博伊更快，托乔依旧不可小觑。5.5 吨铁素体纤维装甲已将其重量级别的防护能力推至上限，使它成为灵活而坚韧的侦察或游击单位。

column1: Let me tell you about this one. It's a quad, and quads never really got respect until this design landed the SLDF contract nobody thought was possible after the Xanthos flopped two centuries back. The engineer named it after his own homeworld in the Free Worlds League, which I always thought was a nice touch. Heavy armor and real agility made up for the light weapons load in the right hands. When the civil war hit, the factory kept changing hands, and eventually its own side blew it up rather than let the Rim Worlds keep the tech.
column2: 让我来介绍一下这台。它是四足机，在这款设计拿下那份没人认为可能的SLDF合同之前，四足机一直得不到真正的尊重——而那已经是Xanthos惨败两百年后的事了。工程师以自己在自由世界联盟的故乡为它命名，我一直觉得这一点很有心。厚重装甲和真正的机动性弥补了武器配置偏轻的问题，只要交到合适的人手里。内战爆发后，工厂几经易手，最终它的阵营宁愿把工厂炸掉，也不让边疆世界保留这项技术。

column1: The Rasalhague Dominion has long relied on the Dragonfly "Viper" Medium OmniMech, which showed its age after shifting to the Inner Sphere. By early 3100, a replacement was needed. Their top technicians developed several prototypes before finalizing the Björn - named after the ancient Swedish word for "bear." The Björn succeeds the Viper with the latest 32nd-century technology. Following the Kodiak's example, it is becoming a totem 'Mech for the clan, with many warriors competing for the honor of piloting this new "symbol of the bear."
column2: 拉萨哈格联盟长期依赖龙蜻蜓“毒蛇”中型Omni机甲，但转入内天体后，这款机体已显老态。3100年初，他们需要一款替代品。顶尖技术人员开发了数个原型，最终定型为比约恩——名称源自古老瑞典语中的“熊”。比约恩以最新的32世纪技术接替毒蛇。仿照Kodiak的先例，它正逐渐成为氏族的图腾机甲，许多战士争相获得驾驶这头“熊之象征”的荣誉。

column1: The Sidewinder is a high-speed OmniMech developed by the Star Adders, drawing inspiration from the Cephalus but avoiding banned tech. Built across three facilities—including Strana Mechty, Huntress, and a Deep Periphery site—it’s favored by scout and headhunter Stars. A 250 XXL engine, Endo-Steel chassis, and Supercharger push speeds over 150 kph. Though armed lightly due to limited pod space, it’s one of the fastest OmniMechs ever made. Its 6.5 tons of Ferro-Lamellor armor offer solid protection, but it can't sustain prolonged combat.
column2: 响尾蛇是星蝰蛇开发的高速Omni机甲，设计灵感来自Cephalus，同时避开了禁用技术。它在三座设施生产——包括Strana Mechty、Huntress和一处深层边疆工厂——深受侦察星和猎头星青睐。250级XXL引擎、Endo-Steel骨架和增压器让速度超过150公里/小时。虽然受舱段空间限制而武装偏轻，它仍是有史以来最快的Omni机甲之一。6.5吨Ferro-Lamellor装甲提供了可靠防护，但无法长时间持续作战。

column1: The Stone Lion developed the Haider, a heavy OmniMech based on an upgraded Summoner chassis and armor, produced using equipment moved from St. Louis MechWorks to Industriplex Alpha to centralize manufacturing and simplify battlefield repairs. Production began in early 3136 at two sites. The Haider features a supercharger allowing bursts up to 103 kph, 32.5 tons of pod space, and uses an Extra-Extra Light engine to maximize capacity, balanced by reinforced engine armor. All variants include targeting computers and 12 tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor.
column2: 石狮开发的海德尔是一款重型Omni机甲，基于升级后的召唤者底盘和装甲打造；生产采用从圣路易斯机甲工厂迁至工业中心Alpha的设备，以集中制造并简化战场维修。生产于3136年初在两处地点启动。海德尔配备增压器，短时爆发速度可达103公里/小时，拥有32.5吨舱段空间，并使用超超轻引擎最大化载荷，辅以强化引擎装甲进行平衡。所有变体都配备目标锁定计算机和12吨Ferro-Fibrous装甲。

column1:
After several hours of thorough searching by the customs crew, their officer approaches you, clipboard in hand. You can see a mix of red and green check marks on the list.

He clicks his pen officiously. "Commander, you run an adequately respectable ship here. I'm prepared to let you enter the port. After we've finished confiscating the following items and you've paid a small fine."

As expected, they've discovered a number of illicit materials on board, mostly among the personal effects of your MechWarriors. This won't sit well with the crew.
column2:
海关人员彻底搜查了数小时后，他们的官员拿着剪贴板走向你。你能看到清单上红绿相间的勾选标记。

他装腔作势地按动钢笔。“指挥官，你们的船总体还算体面。我准备让你们进入港口——当然，要先没收以下物品，并缴纳一笔小额罚款。”

不出所料，他们在船上发现了不少违禁材料，其中大多藏在机甲战士的个人物品中。这下船员们肯定不会高兴。

column1: The Ion Sparrow, initially designated as the Butcherbird when first encountered by the Lyran Intelligence Corps, was introduced by Clan Jade Falcon on Alyina as an experimental testbed for the advanced partial wing system. The Ion Sparrow uses an endo steel chassis, XL engine, ferro-fibrous armor, and small cockpit to save weight. Eight jump jets have been mounted in the right and left torso, and when paired with the partial wing, allows the Ion Sparrow to cover 300 meters per jump. The wing also works with the double heat sinks to dissipate more heat.
column2: 离子麻雀最初被莱茵情报兵团发现时，代号为屠鸟；随后，玉衡鹰氏族在Alyina推出它，作为先进局部翼系统的实验测试平台。离子麻雀采用Endo Steel骨架、XL引擎、Ferro-Fibrous装甲和小型驾驶舱以减轻重量。左右躯干安装了八台跳跃喷射器，与局部翼配合后，每次跳跃可跨越300米。机翼还能与双重散热器协同，散去更多热量。

column1: The Raider was an unusual experimental medium BattleMech, which was the brain child of a Republican Industrialist named Jacob Bannson. The design was created as a means to skirt around Republic of the Sphere restrictions on military hardware under the project name ''Jacob's Ladder'', and Bannson's technical and engineering teams would utilize whatever technology they could access to reach their goal. The resulting design turned out to be not necessarily a failure, with the Raider proving to be a commercial success when it first appeared on the battlefields by 3134.
column2: 掠袭者是一款不同寻常的实验型中型战斗机甲，由共和国工业家Jacob Bannson构想。该设计以“Jacob的梯子”为项目名，旨在绕开星际共和国对军用硬件的限制；Bannson的技术和工程团队会利用能接触到的一切技术来实现目标。最终设计谈不上失败：掠袭者在3134年首次出现在战场时，证明了自己在商业上取得成功。

column1: The Tundra Wolf was the first brand new Clan Wolf BattleMech fully developed and solely produced in the Inner Sphere. With losses mounting during the Word of Blake's Jihad, rather than a costly and complex OmniMech, Wolf technicians focused on producing a standard generalist design that could be readily manufactured and fill as many roles within their depleted touman as possible. While somewhat slow for a Clan-made 75-ton 'Mech, the Tundra Wolf made up for that with MASC, that allowed it to sprint in bursts and jump jets, enabling it to leap up to 120 meters at a time.
column2: 冻原狼是狼氏族第一款全新战斗机甲，完全在内天体开发并独立生产。黑暗圣战期间损失不断增加，狼氏族技术人员没有选择昂贵而复杂的Omni机甲，而是专注于生产一款易于量产、能在兵力衰减的战团中承担尽可能多角色的标准通用设计。对于一台氏族制造的75吨机甲而言，冻原狼速度略慢，但它以MASC弥补不足，可进行短时冲刺；再加上跳跃喷射器，每次能跃过120米。

column1: The Kopis battle armor was designed by StarCorps Industries as an assault unit. Slow but heavily armed, the Kopis can remain on the battlefield supporting friendly units for a long time. The advanced armor used by the Kopis designers allows it to stand up to most weaponry, shrugging off anything short of a PPC or AC/10 hit. The low top speed is mitigated through the use of VTOL transportation for offensive operations, while smart commanders use the Kopis as a defense unit for cities or other tight terrain. In those restricted environments the low top speed isn't a factor.
column2: Kopis战斗装甲由StarCorps Industries设计，定位为突击单位。它速度缓慢但武装厚重，能长期留在战场支援友军。Kopis设计师采用的先进装甲足以抵御大多数武器，除了PPC或AC/10命中外几乎都能硬扛。较低的最高速度通过VTOL运输用于进攻行动来弥补；而精明的指挥官会把Kopis用作城市或其他狭窄地形的防御单位。在这些受限环境中，低速并不构成问题。

column1:
After almost a full day of meticulous searching by the customs crew, their officer approaches you, clipboard in hand. You can see mostly red check marks on the list.

He clicks his pen rapidly in annoyance. "Commander, you run a sloppy ship here. Nevertheless, I'm prepared to let you enter the port. After we've finished confiscating the following items and you've paid a fine."

As expected, they've discovered a number of illicit materials on board, as well as a broad list of "infractions" with vague descriptions. This won't help your reputation with the local government.
column2:
海关人员一丝不苟地搜查了将近一整天后，他们的官员拿着剪贴板走向你。你看到清单上几乎全是红色勾选标记。

他恼怒地飞快按动钢笔。“指挥官，你们的船管理得很马虎。不过我准备让你们进入港口——当然，要先没收以下物品，并缴纳罚款。”

不出所料，他们不仅发现了不少违禁材料，还列出了一长串描述含糊的“违规事项”。这可不会改善你们在当地政府那里的声誉。

column1: The Hierofalcon is a medium Clan OmniMech designed primarily as a striker unit by Clan Jade Falcon. As part of the push to be ever more flexible in movement, the 'Mech features a 270-rated extralight engine, allowing the mech to move at speeds up to 97.2 km/h. The addition of a permanently equipped partial wing adds dual benefits, both increasing jump distance and cooling capabilities. The 'Mech's hull is protected by seven and a half tons of ferro-fibrous armor, giving it modest protection from enemy fire, while an ECM suite provides additional protection from other threats.
column2: 层云鹰是玉衡鹰氏族设计的中型氏族Omni机甲，主要定位为突击单位。为了让机体行动更加灵活，它配备了270级超轻引擎，最高速度可达97.2公里/小时。永久安装的局部翼带来双重收益，既增加跳跃距离，也提升散热能力。机体由7.5吨Ferro-Fibrous装甲保护，能抵御敌方火力但防护适中；ECM套件则提供额外的威胁防护。

column1: The Lightray was designed by Martinson Armaments to be a heavy scout 'Mech. The Lightray is built on a lightweight endo steel chassis to help maximize the available weight for weapons and equipment, and features a gigantic 385 XL engine, the largest that can possibly be carried by a 'Mech its size. This engine allows the scout 'Mech to outpace most other medium designs with a top speed of 118 km/h, though it lacks the added maneuverability that could be provided by jump jets. The Lightray carries ten and a half tons of ferro-fibrous armor, giving the 'Mech a great deal of protection
column2: 光线是Martinson Armaments设计的重型侦察机甲。它采用轻量Endo Steel骨架，以尽量增加武器和设备的可用重量，并配备385级巨型XL引擎，这是同吨位机甲能够搭载的最大引擎。该引擎让这台侦察机甲以118公里/小时的最高速度超过大多数其他中型设计，但它没有跳跃喷射器带来的额外机动性。光线搭载10.5吨Ferro-Fibrous装甲，为机体提供了很强的防护。

column1: With the bad reputation the Sarath had obtained, the Free Worlds League approved the creation of a 140 ton superheavy version in an attempt to regain some of the design lines reputation. The task of designing it was once again given to Ronin Inc, and the result was the Narayana Omni QuadMech. Its main focus are on indirect fire support with a 425 XL engine to ensure the QuadMech is mobile enough to reposition without too much delay. Eventually a deal was struck with House Steiner to also provide them with a number of Narayana, making that the only other faction to field any of the 'Mechs.
column2: 由于Sarath声名狼藉，自由世界联盟批准制造一款140吨超重型版本，试图挽回这一设计系列的声誉。设计任务再次交给Ronin公司，产物便是Narayana Omni四足机甲。它主要专注于间接火力支援，配备425级XL引擎，确保四足机甲能及时重新部署。最终，联盟与Steiner家族达成协议，向其提供若干Narayana，使后者成为唯一拥有这款机甲的其他派系。

column1: The Gray Death Infiltrator Suit was the successor to the Infiltrator Mk. I, and while intended to fill a range of battlefield roles, it performed best as a scout or skirmisher. Nicknamed the Quokka, the Gray Death Infiltrator Suit was configured to be highly mobile and incorporated a Parafoil to allow it to make precise aerial drops. The Gray Death Infiltrator Suit was capable of making swarm and leg attacks as well as being able to travel by mechanized transport. Each suit had a Basic Manipulator mounted on each arm and had more than a third of a ton of basic stealth armor for protection.
column2: 灰死神渗透装甲是渗透者I型的后继型号，虽然设计目标涵盖多种战场职责，但最擅长侦察和游击。灰死神渗透装甲因昵称“短尾矮袋鼠”而闻名，配置高度机动，并配备伞翼以实现精准空投。它能够发动蜂群攻击和腿部攻击，也可以通过机械化运输移动。每套装甲的双臂各装有一具基础操纵器，并配备超过三分之一吨的基础隐形装甲用于防护。

column1: The Gryphon, built from an improved Hellbringer chassis, is Clan Stone Lion’s durable heavy OmniMech. It features thick Ferro-Lamellor armor—nearly double that of its predecessor—25.5 tons of pod space, and a supercharged 325 XL engine with 10 double heat sinks. Though slightly lighter than the Hellbringer, it delivers strong protection and firepower, reaching speeds over 100 kph briefly. Manufactured mainly on Niles, the Gryphon is agile and tough, with five flexible variants and the unique ability to carry Battle Armored troops into combat, making it a key unit in Clan Stone Lion’s touman.
column2: 狮鹫由改良的地狱使者底盘打造，是石狮坚韧的重型Omni机甲。它配备厚重的Ferro-Lamellor装甲，几乎是前代的两倍；拥有25.5吨舱段空间，以及带10个双重散热器的增压325级XL引擎。虽然比地狱使者略轻，它仍能提供强大防护与火力，短时间内速度可超过100公里/小时。狮鹫主要在尼尔斯生产，兼具灵活与坚固，拥有五种多用途变体，还能将战斗装甲部队带入战场，因此成为石狮战团的关键单位。

column1: When the Capellan Confederation needed a new 'Mech to export, House Liao decided the easiest and cheapest way was to "acquire" the design of the Sunder OmniMech from a certain neighbor Inner Sphere state. To prevent any accusations about using their design without permissions, House Liao scientists then decided to simply upscale the design and make it a superheavy. This is how the 165 ton Wannu OmniMech was born, which then was exported to both the Lyrans and the Suns. Some even found their way back to the Draconis Combine, although House Kurita did refuse to buy any directly for some reason.
column2: 当卡佩兰联邦需要一款新的机甲用于出口时，廖家认为最容易、最便宜的办法，是从某个邻近的内天体国家“取得”Sunder Omni机甲的设计。为了避免被指控未经许可使用他人设计，廖家科学家决定干脆把设计放大，做成超重型机甲。165吨的Wannu Omni机甲就这样诞生了，随后出口给莱茵人和太阳联邦。甚至有一些回到了龙蛇共和国内，不过库里塔家族出于某种原因拒绝直接购买。

column1: The Arctos is a pure Society design based on the Minsk, and as such is carrying a lot of experimental and cutting edge technology that is still not generally available. Through the use of Ferro-Carbide Shell armor and Endo Titanium structure enough weight is saved to enable the Arctos to both be heavily armored and still mount a considerable weaponry with a large damage potential - it even still is somewhat mobile for a superheavy thanks to its large XL engine. To remaining noticeable features includes an Advanced Torso Cockpit, a head mounted Advanced Laser AMS and prototype double heat sinks.
column2: Arctos是Society基于Minsk打造的纯Society设计，因此搭载了大量尚未普及的实验性尖端技术。通过使用Ferro-Carbide Shell装甲和Endo Titanium结构，它节省了足够重量，既能装备厚重装甲，又能安装大量武器、造成可观伤害；得益于大型XL引擎，它作为超重型机甲仍保有一定机动性。其他显著特征包括先进躯干驾驶舱、安装于头部的先进激光AMS，以及原型双重散热器。

column1:
Sumire reports a call for help from a nearby ship. "It's another ship that's contracted the Periphery Pox."

Darius begins to speak, but Dr. Murad cuts him off. "I know what our XO will say." She continues in a perfect imitation of Darius, "We went to the trouble of developing this serum, let's make back some of that investment!"

With a smile, Darius plays along. "Speaking for our dear Dr. Murad, we've suffered from the Pox ourselves. Let's give away our serum, and maybe the locals will smile at us afterward."

Dr. Murad finishes with, "If we do sell the serum, I think we could easily get ¢80k."
column2:
Sumire报告附近一艘船发来求助。“又有一艘船感染了边疆瘟疫。”

Darius正要开口，却被Murad博士打断。“我知道我们的副执行官会说什么。”她用完美的Darius口吻继续道：“我们费了这么大劲开发这种血清，总得收回一部分投入吧！”

Darius笑着配合道：“我谨代表我们亲爱的Murad博士发言：我们自己也遭受过这种瘟疫。把血清送给他们吧，说不定当地人之后会对我们露出笑脸。”

Murad博士最后说道：“如果出售血清，我觉得轻松就能拿到¢80k。”

column1: Sumire explains the unpleasant variation in the usual planetary approach. "Commander, the port authorities want to search us. Apparently the Argo's gotten onto a watch-list because of our tendency to be spotted in the company of pirates. If we choose not to comply, we're going to pay a hefty fine." Yang sounds skeptical. "If they do search us, I bet they're going to find something to complain about -- real or not." Darius has been notably quiet. "Or... we can try to bribe the inspectors." He grins. "I can work some connections to try to arrange for a sympathetic ear when they come aboard."
column2: Sumire解释了这次行星靠港与往常不同的糟糕之处。“指挥官，港口当局要搜查我们。显然，Argo因为我们经常和海盗一起出现，已经上了监视名单。如果我们选择不配合，就得支付一大笔罚款。” Yang听起来将信将疑。“如果他们真的搜查，我敢打赌他们肯定会找出些东西来抱怨——不管是真是假。” Darius一直异常安静。“或者……我们可以试着贿赂检查员。”他咧嘴一笑。“我可以动用一些关系，尽量安排他们登船时听得进话的人。”

column1: The Attor is Clan Cloud Cobra's totem assault OmniMech, developed to replace the aging Highlander IIC. Named after an old Terran word for "poison," it emphasizes raw power and battlefield resilience. With 15 tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, integral CASE II, and a built-in Supercharger, the Attor is both durable and mobile. Each variant includes advanced electronics such as Angel ECM, Active Probes, or Targeting Computers. Despite having 41 tons of pod space, the design avoids lighter weapons entirely. The Attor follows a "go big or go home" philosophy, making it a distinctive and dangerous presence in any combat scenario.
column2: Attor是云蛇氏族的图腾级突击Omni机甲，旨在替代老旧的Highlander IIC。名称源自古老地球语中“毒药”一词，强调纯粹的力量与战场韧性。它配备15吨Ferro-Fibrous装甲、内置CASE II和自带增压器，兼顾耐久与机动。每种变体都包含先进电子设备，如天使ECM、主动探测器或目标锁定计算机。尽管拥有41吨舱段空间，该设计完全不采用轻型武器。Attor遵循“要么做大，要么回家”的理念，在任何战斗场景中都是独特而危险的存在。

column1: Initially under development by Clan Ghost Bear as directed by Galaxy Commander Ramiel \"Warbear\" Bekker and named for the Grecian nymph in the Terran constellation of Ursa Major, the Callisto was designed to correct a tactical deficiency in the Rasalhague Dominion's infantry. The development resulted in two near identical versions of the Battle Armor, with only serial numbers and machining details being the only major differentiation between the two. The Callisto is based on the time tested Elemental Battle Suit making it a both recognizable, if a bit peculiar sight, and easy for warriors to switch to should the need arise.
column2: Callisto 最初由幽灵熊氏族在银河指挥官 Ramiel \"Warbear\" Bekker 的指导下研发，其名称取自地球大熊座中的希腊仙女。它旨在弥补拉萨哈格自治领步兵部队的战术短板。最终诞生了两种几乎完全相同的战斗装甲，主要区别只有序列号和加工细节。Callisto 以经过时间检验的元素战士战斗服为基础，既容易辨认（虽然外形略显古怪），也便于战士在需要时改用。

column1: The Black Wolf is a thirty-second century, Heavy Class battle armor which was originally created by Clan Scientists from both halves of the divided Wolf Clan. The battle armor began as a joint project between Clan Wolf and Clan Wolf-in-Exile, as part of a means of reunification between the two sundered factions. However, the reunification the Black Wolf suggested would not come to pass with the later formation of the Wolf Empire in 3142. One of the Black Wolf's deployments would be during the invasion of Tharkad in 3143, where the suit's use would become a symbol of terror for Clan Wolf-in-Exile's allies in the Lyran Commonwealth.
column2: Black Wolf 是一款诞生于 32 世纪的重型战斗装甲，最初由分裂后的狼氏族两方科学家共同研制。它起初是狼氏族与流亡狼氏族的联合项目，意在促成这两个分裂派系重新统一。然而，Black Wolf 所寄托的统一并未实现，3142 年狼帝国的成立反而让这一愿景化为泡影。3143 年入侵 Tharkad 时，Black Wolf 曾投入战斗；这套装甲的出现，后来成为流亡狼氏族在利拉联邦盟友心中的恐怖象征。

column1: The Tomahawk is an assault-class OmniMech designed by Clan Wolf in 3065. By September of that year, a few prototypes had been built and were being tested in trial runs. One these prototypes was piloted by Nathan Wolf in a Circle of Equals on Tamar when he attained the rank of Star Colonel. Although he was victorious against a Thor, it was noted that the Tomahawk still suffered from numerous system errors and gremlins and was not yet ready for mass production. Still, Nathan retained the 'Mech for his subsequent assignment to Omega Galaxy and successfully piloted it in combat on Novo Cressidas in the Star's End system on 11 April 3064.
column2: Tomahawk 是狼氏族于 3065 年设计的强袭级全能机甲。同年 9 月，数台原型机已经造出并开始试运行。其中一台原型机由 Nathan Wolf 驾驶，在 Tamar 的平等圆环决斗中帮助他晋升为星际上校。虽然他击败了 Thor，但人们发现 Tomahawk 仍存在大量系统故障和小毛病，尚未准备好量产。尽管如此，Nathan 仍在随后调往 Omega 星群时保留了这台机甲，并于 3064 年 4 月 11 日在 Star's End 星系的 Novo Cressidas 作战中成功驾驭它。

column1: The Hierophant is a 200-ton superheavy OmniMech fielded by the Minnesota Tribe as a battlefield oracle, commanding, interpreting, and unleashing battlefield truth with devastating clarity. Named for the ancient spiritual title of one who reveals sacred mysteries, the Hierophant embodies the Tribe’s view of war as a ritual of revelation. Exclusively piloted by high-ranking commanders, it serves as both a strategic nerve center and an unyielding war idol. Powered by a volatile Magnothermic Plasma Engine and cooled with advanced Plasmo-Electric Heat Sinks, the Hierophant stands as a towering symbol of the Tribe’s grim, transcendent purpose.
column2: Hierophant 是一台 200 吨级超重型全能机甲，由明尼苏达部落部署为战场神谕，负责指挥、解读并以毁灭性的清晰度揭示战场真相。它的名字源自古老的宗教称号，指代揭示神圣奥秘之人；Hierophant 体现了部落将战争视为启示仪式的观念。它只由高级指挥官驾驶，既是战略中枢，也是坚不可摧的战争图腾。Hierophant 由不稳定的磁热等离子引擎驱动，并以先进的等离子电热散热器冷却，巍然象征着部落阴郁而超然的使命。

As you hand the noteputer back to Darius, you turn towards Howe, "Thank you for this information. I think we will need to go with the Cost Saver Package. We are on a pretty tight budget and while I realize there are potential risks and issues, the savings will go towards keeping {COMPANY.CompanyName} afloat. Darius, make the arrangements." column2: 你一边浏览笔记本电脑上精确的数据，一边思索 Howe Zeng 刚才向你说明的一切。把笔记本电脑递还给 Darius 后，你转向 Howe：“谢谢你的说明。我想我们需要选择节省成本方案。我们的预算相当紧张，虽然我知道这其中可能存在风险和问题，但省下来的钱能让 {COMPANY.CompanyName} 继续运转。Darius，安排下去。” Darius 点头，将 Zeng 先生送回他的穿梭机：“明白，指挥官。” 伽马舱升级已解锁 前往工程部开始建造升级

As you hand the noteputer back to Darius, you turn towards Izelda, "Thank you for this information. I think we will need to go with the Cost Saver Package. We are on a pretty tight budget and while I realize there are potential risks and issues, the savings will go towards keeping {COMPANY.CompanyName} afloat. Darius, make the arrangements." Darius nods as he escorts Ms Berrix back to her DropShip, "Understood, Commander" BETA POD UPGRADE UNLOCKED VISIT ENGINEERING TO BEGIN UPGRADE CONSTRUCTION
column2: 你一边浏览笔记本电脑上精确的数据，一边思索 Izelda Berrix 刚才向你说明的一切。把笔记本电脑递还给 Darius 后，你转向 Izelda：“谢谢你的说明。我想我们需要选择节省成本方案。我们的预算相当紧张，虽然我知道这其中可能存在风险和问题，但省下来的钱能让 {COMPANY.CompanyName} 继续运转。Darius，安排下去。” Darius 点头，将 Berrix 女士送回她的穿梭机：“明白，指挥官。” 贝塔舱升级已解锁 前往工程部开始建造升级

column1: The Carrion Crow is a Raven Alliance OmniMech designed alongside the heavier and more expensive War Crow. Deployment of the Carrion Crow is limited to the Raven touman, with the Alliance Military Corps not receiving any of these 'Mechs. A fast medium 'Mech, the Carrion Crow is intended to be a standard medium 'Mech for the Alliance. The Carrion Crow is built on an endo steel chassis, which houses its 280-rated XL engine that allows the 'Mech to move at a top speed of 111 km/h. Protection is provided by nine and a half tons of ferro-lamellor armor, while 14.5 tons of pod space allows the Carrion Crow to carry weapons that let it effectively fight heavier units.
column2: Carrion Crow 是鸦之联盟与更重、更昂贵的 War Crow 同步设计的全能机甲。它仅部署于鸦之部落，联盟军团不会获得任何一台。Carrion Crow 是一台高速中型机甲，定位是联盟的标准中型机甲。它采用内骨骼钢结构，搭载 280 级 XL 引擎，最高速度可达 111 km/h。九吨半的铁素体层叠装甲提供防护，14.5 吨挂载舱则让 Carrion Crow 能携带足以有效对抗重型单位的武器。

column1: The Regent was born when Coventry Metal Works, the designers of the Hauptmann, managed to secure construction rights for an updated version of the original design after help by the ilKhanate. The efficiency of Clan technology meant that the Hauptmann could be replicated on a lighter chassis. Coventry technicians revised their schematics to employ the more readily available 270-rated engine and Clan heat sinks. The 'Mech shed five tons and a significant amount in production costs. Many MechWarriors refer to the resulting product as the Awesomann, a ridiculous yet accurate nickname for the imposing 'Mech, leading pilots of alternate configurations to call their rides Fafnirmann, Maulermann, and others.
column2: Regent 诞生于 Coventry 金属工厂获得原始设计更新版的建造权之后；这家公司正是 Hauptmann 的设计者，并在 ilKhan 给予帮助后取得了许可。氏族科技的高效率意味着 Hauptmann 可以用更轻的底盘复制出来。Coventry 技师修改图纸，采用更容易获得的 270 级引擎和氏族散热器。该机甲减重五吨，生产成本也大幅下降。许多机甲战士把成品称为 Awesomann——这个绰号荒唐却准确地描述了这台魁梧机甲，因此其他配置的驾驶员也把自己的座驾称为 Fafnirmann、Maulermann 等。

column1: The Nyx is a light BattleMech originally developed by the Word of Blake in the late Jihad. The Blakists' designs for the 'Mech and a prototype were captured by the Allied Coalition's Draconis Combine force on Quentin in 3077,[4] and were rushed off to the Draconis Combine's Diplan MechYards, where engineers did not have the resources to put the advanced design into production. After the liberation of Terra in 3079, the Combine would ask aide from the new Terran government to assist with development of the 'Mech. It would be jointly produced by both the Republic and Combine, prior to the very end of the Jihad. The design was conceived as a speedy recon 'Mech, with a 300 XL engine allowing it to reach 162 km/h.
column2: Nyx 是一款轻型战斗机甲，最初由 Blake 之言在圣战末期研发。3077 年，盟军联军中的龙辰联邦部队在 Quentin 缴获了 Blake 教徒的设计图和一台原型机[4]，随后紧急送往龙辰联邦的 Diplan 机甲厂；那里的工程师缺乏将这项先进设计投入生产的资源。3079 年 Terra 解放后，龙辰联邦向新成立的地球政府求助，请其协助开发这台机甲。圣战结束前，它由球体共和国与龙辰联邦联合生产。该设计定位为高速侦察机甲，配备 300 级 XL 引擎，最高速度可达 162 km/h。

column1: Needing to build up its forces after establishing the Wolf Empire and wanting a more generalist unit than the Skinwalker, Clan Wolf's Ramiel Bekker created the Stormwolf in collaboration with Clan Sea Fox by modifying the Wendigo to the Clan's exacting specifications. The 'Mech was designed with the intention of striking a balance between firepower and speed, and chief among Bekker's modifications was the addition of fixed mobility-enhancing equipment in order to shape the 'Mech's role in combat, as well as relocating the 'Mech's cockpit to the head. This relocation's associated visual changes gave the 'Mech a more canid or ursid appearance, bringing it more in line with the earlier Wulfen and Warwolf aesthetically.
column2: 在建立狼帝国后，为了扩充兵力并获得比 Skinwalker 更全能的单位，狼氏族的 Ramiel Bekker 与海狐氏族合作，按照氏族严格的规格改造 Wendigo，创造了 Stormwolf。该机甲旨在平衡火力与速度；Bekker 最重要的改动，是加入固定式机动增强设备以塑造其战斗定位，并将驾驶舱移至头部。这一改动带来的外观变化让机甲更像犬科或熊科动物，在美学上也更接近早期的 Wulfen 和 Warwolf。

column1: Designed by Defiance Industries, the Storm Raider was intended to be an alternative to the Hollander light 'Mech. Unfortunately for Defiance, the Storm Raider was 50 years too late for the market, and the various prototypes were poorly received - so poorly received, in fact, that Defiance licensed all of the designs to Coventry Metal Works. Coventry Metal Works was manufacturing four different variants of the Storm Raider intended for use in urban defense roles or for small-scale surgical strikes, but the Storm Raider was a poor performer in both roles, outgunned by contemporaries and slower than most. Despite that, the Storm Raider proved an able fighter in the arenas at Solaris VII, where it became a fan favorite.
column2: Storm Raider 由 Defiance 工业设计，原本是 Hollander 轻型机甲的替代方案。遗憾的是，它进入市场晚了 50 年，各种原型机的评价都很差——差到 Defiance 最终把全部设计授权给 Coventry 金属工厂。Coventry 金属工厂生产了四种不同变体，用于城市防御或小规模外科式突袭，但 Storm Raider 在这两种任务中的表现都很糟糕：火力被同时代机甲压制，速度也比大多数对手更慢。尽管如此，Storm Raider 在 Solaris VII 的竞技场中仍证明了自己的战斗力，并在那里成为观众最喜爱的机甲之一。

column1: The Inferno heavy OmniMech was introduced by StarCorps Industries of Crofton after New Avalon fell to the Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery in the Dark Age. With twenty-nine tons of pod space available and protected by thirteen and a half tons of armor, the Inferno became a popular unit in the AFFS. By building on an Endo-Steel chassis with a Compact Gyro engineers were able to free up a lot of space in the traditionally crowded center torso. This freed room for heavy weapons in the most heavily protected part of the 'Mech. In every configuration the main weapons are mounted in the center torso, with additional weaponry in the side torsos (often in over the shoulder mounts), leaving the arms free for physical attacks.
column2: Inferno 重型全能机甲由 Crofton 的 StarCorps 工业推出，时间是在新 Avalon 于黑暗时代陷落、被龙辰联邦集结军占领之后。它拥有 29 吨挂载舱和 13.5 吨装甲，因此很快成为 AFFS 的热门单位。工程师采用内骨骼钢底盘和紧凑型陀螺仪，从传统上拥挤的中央躯干中腾出了大量空间。这些空间可用于在机甲防护最严密的部位安装重型武器。所有配置都将主武器装在中央躯干，侧躯干则配备额外武器（通常为肩上安装），让双臂能够专注于物理攻击。

column1: The Blade is a light-weight scouting and raiding 'Mech that employs its fearsome speed to strike at larger 'Mechs, then to escape before their opponents can track them. Well-suited for pack-hunter and swarming tactics, the Blade works well with other fast units such as the classic Locust and the Clan Dasher. Originally commissioned by the Republic of the Sphere's first Commanding General Victor Steiner-Davion, the Blade was his attempt to standardize and simplify the hodgepodge military hardware as Stone's Coalition became the Republic Armed Forces. The Blade was manufactured from the mid-3080s until around 3096, becoming the signature 'Mechs for Principes Guards, Hastati Sentinels, and elite Knights of the Sphere regiments.
column2: Blade 是一款轻型侦察与突袭机甲，利用惊人的速度袭击大型机甲，然后在敌人锁定它们之前撤离。它非常适合群狼捕猎和蜂群战术，与经典的 Locust 及氏族 Dasher 等高速单位协同效果出色。Blade 最初由球体共和国首任总司令 Victor Steiner-Davion 下令研制，目的是在 Stone 联盟转变为共和国武装部队时，将杂乱的军用硬件标准化并简化。Blade 从 3080 年代中期生产至约 3096 年，后来成为 Principes Guards、Hastati Sentinels 以及球体骑士精锐团的标志性机甲。

column1: The Warwolf is a Heavy Class OmniMech, first produced by Clan Wolf during the mid-thirty-second century. Conceived as a part of Clan Wolf's movement to replace their old signature Timber Wolf, the Warwolf was designed to be a flexible cavalry unit. Powered by the Timber Wolf's 375-rated Extra-Light Fusion Engine, the Warwolf shares its predecessor's flexible speed. Using the weight savings of the XL Engine and the strength of its endo-steel construction, the Warwolf is able to carry 30 tons worth of OmniPod weapons and equipment. The 'Mech is protected by 14.5 tons of Clan grade reactive armor, giving the Warwolf the ability to ward off explosive type weaponry while retaining the strength of standard armor. In addition to the Warwolf's armor, the 'Mech uses a Laser-based Anti-Missile System to help fight off incoming missile attacks.
column2: Warwolf 是一款重型全能机甲，由狼氏族在 32 世纪中期首次生产。它诞生于狼氏族替换旧标志性机甲 Timber Wolf 的计划，设计目标是一台灵活的骑兵单位。Warwolf 使用 Timber Wolf 的 375 级超轻融合引擎，因此继承了前代的灵活速度。XL 引擎带来的减重以及内骨骼钢结构的强度，让 Warwolf 能携带 30 吨全能挂载武器与设备。机甲配备 14.5 吨氏族级反应装甲，既能抵御爆炸类武器，又保留标准装甲的强度。此外，Warwolf 还使用激光式反导系统，帮助抵御来袭的导弹攻击。

column1: The Prefect was an ammo-independent Republic of the Sphere BattleMech, designed specifically for guerrilla combat. With increasing legal tensions between the newborn Republic and military manufacturers who suffered heavy damage at the hands of Stone's Coalition during Operation SCOUR, Exarch Devlin Stone commissioned a new BattleMech intended to create jobs, bolster his military, and to stave off the worst of the lawsuits. While ultimately unsuccessful on the last count, the well-regarded Prefect would enter service with the public RAF as well as black ops units. Mandating a simple, fast and durable energy weapon design based on the guerrilla-style warfare he conducted in the early years of resistance to the Blakists, Stone was forced to make a number of concessions and include a more expensive Endo Steel chassis along with ferro-fibrous armor, as well as the more fragile Light Fusion Engine and XL Gyro in an attempt to win over the military-industrial complex.
column2: Prefect 是一款无需弹药的球体共和国战斗机甲，专为游击战设计。新生共和国与军工制造商之间的法律矛盾日益加剧，而这些制造商在 Stone 联盟的 SCOUR 行动中遭受重创，于是执政官 Devlin Stone 委托研制了新的战斗机甲，旨在创造就业、增强军力，并避免最严重的诉讼。虽然最后一个目标最终未能实现，广受好评的 Prefect 仍进入共和国武装部队公开编制和黑色行动单位。Stone 要求它采用简单、快速且耐用的能量武器设计，体现自己在早期抵抗 Blake 教徒时使用的游击战术；为争取军工复合体支持，他不得不作出多项妥协，加入更昂贵的内骨骼钢结构和铁素体装甲，以及更脆弱的轻型融合引擎和 XL 陀螺仪。

column1: The Notos is an advanced Heavy-class hybrid between a Quadrupedal OmniMech and Combat Vehicle design, known more simply as a QuadVee, introduced by Clan Hell's Horses. Named after the Greek Goddess of the south wind, the Notos is a more refined QuadVee design in comparison to its earlier predecessors. Retaining the best qualities of the previous models, the machine has been built to support a diverse array of weapon and equipment configurations, while also taking advantage of using wheels in place of tank treads. The Notos can call upon 15 tons worth of equipment allowed by its omnipods. While it sports a modest 12.5 tons of standard armor protection from enemy fire, its true innovation comes with its unique ability: transformation into a combat vehicle. Powered by a 300-Rated Extra-Light Fusion Engine, the vehicular Notos can travel at up to a swift 95 km/h, while in 'Mech mode it can move at a solid 80 km/h. This high speed gives it the capability to keep pace with fast combat formations. Unlike its predecessors, the Notos can move significantly faster over flat terrain thanks to its incorporation of wheels rather than tank treads.
column2: Notos 是一种先进的重型混合设计，将四足全能机甲与战斗载具结合起来，通常简称为 QuadVee，由地狱之马氏族推出。它以希腊南风女神命名，相比早期前代产品，Notos 是更成熟的 QuadVee 设计。它保留了前代型号的优点，支持多种武器和设备配置，同时用轮子取代坦克履带。Notos 的全能挂载舱可容纳 15 吨设备。虽然它只有 12.5 吨标准装甲，真正的创新在于独特能力：变形成战斗载具。车辆模式下，300 级超轻融合引擎可让 Notos 以最高 95 km/h 的速度行驶；机甲模式下则能达到稳定的 80 km/h。这样的高速让它能够跟上快速作战编队。与前代不同，得益于轮式结构而非坦克履带，Notos 在平坦地形上的移动速度明显更快。

column1: You look at Sumire, "I guess we prepare to jump...!" The jump clock slowly counts down... 3... 2... 1..." Moments later, the jumpship's KF Drive activates and that quesy feeling when jumping through space washes over your body. As your vision returns post jump, Darius calls out, "The Captain of the jumpship is furious and is going to file a report with the Mercenary Review Board and the Commercial JumpShip Travel Authority as soon as they finish their shipwide diagnostics and damage assessment." You look out the viewport, seeing a totally different system than the one you expected, "Where the F..." Sumire interupts your outburst, "Commander, it appears we are now in the [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] system, which is over 810 light years away from the closest known civilised system of Ksabi! All stations are reporting operational as well, so we do not appear to have suffered any noticable damage from the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMisjump],misjump]]. You look at Sumire and Dr Murad, both of whom wanted the Console installed, "My head hurts from all of this." You turn to Darius, "Plot a path back to civilisation. I'll be in my office. "
column2: 你看向 Sumire：“看来我们该准备跳跃了……！” 跳跃时钟缓缓倒数……3……2……1……”片刻之后，跳跃舰的 KF 驱动启动，穿越太空时那种令人恶心的感觉席卷全身。 跳跃结束、视线恢复后，Darius 喊道：“跳跃舰长官气坏了，等完成全舰诊断和损伤评估，就会向雇佣兵评议委员会和商业跳跃舰旅行管理局提交报告。” 你望向舷窗，看到的星系完全不是预期的那个：“这他妈是……” Sumire 打断了你的爆发：“指挥官，我们似乎已经身处 [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] 星系，距离已知文明星系 Ksabi 最近也有 810 光年！ 所有空间站都报告运行正常，因此我们似乎没有因 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMisjump],misjump]] 遭受明显损伤。 你看向 Sumire 和 Murad 博士——两人都曾要求安装控制台——说道：“这一切弄得我头疼。” 你转向 Darius：“规划一条返回文明世界的航线。我去办公室。”

column1: No one knows who built this superheavy version of the Urbie, they just started showing up throughout the periphery. The whole 'Mech' is in true Urbie fashion a big gun, jump jets and some lasers to tickle you with.
column2: 没人知道是谁制造了这个Urbie的超重型版本，它们只是开始在边疆各处出现。整台机甲秉承Urbie的风格：一门大炮、跳跃喷口，以及几台只能挠痒痒的激光器。

column1: Ever feel like engine heatsinks were a little bit too efficient? Well now you can do something about it, and gain some tonnage back for your mech at the same time. Try our negative engine cooling systems today!
column2: 有没有觉得引擎散热器有点过于高效？现在你可以对此做点什么，同时为你的机甲腾出一些吨位。立即试用我们的负引擎冷却系统！

column2: 源自Solaris的Streak MRM武器系统将Streak制导与MRM发射器结合，在战斗中带来无与伦比的精度和散热效率。 \n\n 使用Streak MRM弹药。

column1: By combining the latest in advanced micro alloyed polymer technology with prototype Superheavy Stealth armor, RISC has created this highly experimental armor for Superheavy 'Mechs which is both light and good stealth capabilities.
column2: 通过将最新的先进微合金聚合物技术与原型超重型隐形装甲相结合，RISC创造了这种高度实验性的超重型机甲装甲，兼具轻量化和良好的隐形能力。

column1: Boss, this is another one of those Capellan stealth 'Mechs.  This thing is going to be practically invisible to sensors at long ranges and packs decent firepower considering the size of the engine and the bulk that stealth tech takes up.

column1: Named for an ancient God of the Forges, taming the Fires of Olympus, does this OmniMech design do its ancestor, the venerable Warhammer, proud. Built with a specialized Heat Dissipating Armor is it able to withstand incoming heat damage from its opponents.
column2: 这款全能机甲以古代锻造之神命名，驯服奥林匹斯之火；它没有辱没其先祖——威严的 Warhammer。它配备特制散热装甲，能够承受对手造成的热量伤害。

column1: The Ostend is the next 'Mech in the line of the Ost-series by Ostmann Industries. Although a 135 ton Superheavy, the design re-uses a lot of components from the other Ost-series 'Mechs, or were this is not possible they just upsized them for the Superheavy.
column2: Ostend 是 Ostmann Industries Ost 系列的下一款机甲。虽然它是 135 吨超重型机甲，但设计沿用了其他 Ost 系列机甲的大量部件；无法沿用的部分，则直接放大为适用于超重型机甲的尺寸。

column1: The Gauntlet is a medium-class OmniMech that was manufactured for the Lyran Commonwealth Armed Forces. It was designed as a swift cavalry unit capable of keeping up with lighter 'Mechs while also being able to bring the flexibility and firepower of a medium 'Mech.
column2: Gauntlet 是一款为莱拉联邦武装部队制造的中型全能机甲。它被设计成快速骑兵单位，既能跟上轻型机甲，又能发挥中型机甲的灵活性和火力。

column1: Renewing the Mad Cat legend, the Mk IV used some of the most powerful configurations of its grand brother, while also incorporating easier to find and replace components. Clan Sea Fox expected to experience the same success with this model, as it had with previous ones.
column2: 重铸 Mad Cat 传奇，Mk IV 采用了其伟大前身最强大的几种配置，同时整合了更容易找到和替换的部件。海狐氏族期待这一型号取得与前代相同的成功。

column1: A pirate captured Moozilla, adding two custom Flamers but maintaining most of the other equipment, including the two massive Boosters and heavy melee equipment. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.32
column2: 一名海盗捕获了 Moozilla，添加了两具定制火焰喷射器，同时保留了大部分其他设备，包括两台巨型助推器和重型近战装备。 特性：扰乱 部署费用倍率：1.32

column1: Based on recovered Clan Crossbows and ancient SLDF experimental notes, RISC and Skobel Engineers managed to create a more modern Crossbow. Employing an experimental Extra-Light Gyro and Light Engine on an Endo-Steel chassis, they managed to upgrade both its mobility and firepower.
column2: RISC 与 Skobel 工程师根据回收的氏族 Crossbow 以及古老的 SLDF 实验笔记，成功打造出更现代的 Crossbow。他们在内骨骼钢底盘上采用实验型超轻陀螺仪和轻型引擎，成功同时提升了其机动性和火力。

column1: A Marik built missile boat, made to prove the Free Worlds League could field top tier tech like Artemis IV and ferro-fibrous armor same as anyone else. Heavy on firepower, light on protection for an 85 tonner. Faded out as the Succession Wars ate away at the advanced parts it needed.
column2: 这是一艘由 Marik 制造的导弹艇，用来证明自由世界联盟和其他势力一样，也能部署 Artemis IV 和铁素体装甲等顶尖技术。对于 85 吨级单位而言，它火力强大却防护薄弱。继承战争逐渐耗尽其所需的先进部件后，它最终淡出历史。

column2: Ferox 2 用两支高斯步枪和一门头部安装的大型脉冲激光器，替换了 Ferox 1 的 ER PPC。 特性：稳定武器 部署费用倍率：1.5 手臂执行器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: The Raiden II series was based on a standard Raiden whose armor was replaced with Reflective Armor. Quirk: Well Designed Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
column2: Raiden II 系列基于标准 Raiden，其装甲被替换为反射装甲。 特性：设计精良 部署费用倍率：0.888 可搭载全能单位，可近战，可群袭。

column1: This one's mostly a copycat, boss, based on Wasp blueprints stolen by Capellan Confederation agents. Only ever built for House Liao, and the factory got wiped out early in the Succession Wars so it never spread far before vanishing. Odd choice giving it five jump jets instead of six though.
column2: 老板，这台基本上是山寨货，设计基于卡佩兰联邦特工盗取的 Wasp 蓝图。它只为廖家制造过；工厂在继承战争初期被摧毁，因此还没来得及广泛传播就销声匿迹了。不过，把它设计成五具跳跃喷口而不是六具，确实有点奇怪。

column1: Created at the very end of the SLDF, the Cameron is a 200 ton superheavy named after the founder and original First Lord of the StarLeague, Ian Cameron. The design is generally focused on high damage through combined weapons, with plenty of specialized equipment to improve their performance.
column2: Cameron 于 SLDF 末期制造，是一台 200 吨超重型机甲，名称源自星盟创始人兼首任第一领主 Ian Cameron。该设计总体专注于通过组合武器实现高额伤害，并配备大量专用设备来提升武器性能。

Naming the mech after themselves shows a lot of hybris, especially since most of the band ended up dying when their illegal 'Mech factory blew up due to someone using rum as the coolant for the fusion power core.
