column1: This Shadowcat seems to have been looted during a Battle in the Combine and subsequently stolen by a member of the Legion of Vega before joining the ranks of a Local Pirate Gang.
column2: 这台Shadowcat似乎是在龙马联盟的一场战斗中被洗劫，后来又被Vega军团成员偷走，最终加入当地海盗团。

column1: The PPC's this thing is loaded with would be a marvel of engineering if it weren't for thier heat output. 'Streak' PPCs they may be, but they're twice as hot as any respectable PPC of comparable damage. Still, if you have a mech with limited cooling capacity, they make for a neat trick.
column2: 如果不是热量输出，这东西装载的PPC会是工程奇迹。“Streak”PPC也许如此，但它们的热量是同等伤害、同等规格正规PPC的两倍。不过如果你的机甲散热能力有限，这倒是个有趣的把戏。

column1: Based upon the Clan Stone Rhino and original Matar designs left on Terra's Skobel Mechworks, acting as a Testbed for the Republics SuperHeavy Research Projects does the Dreadnought forever advance on a enemies Position.
column2: Dreadnought以泰拉Skobel机甲工厂留下的氏族Stone Rhino和原始Matar设计为基础，作为共和国超重型研究项目的测试台，永远向敌方阵地推进。

column1: This thing is wild, Boss. Seems like the RISC engineers left those blazing-hot pulse lasers on the arms, but removed the Clan ATMs and instead filled out the torsos with their own brand of specialty missiles and a heavy-duty AMS.
column2: 老板，这东西太疯狂了。RISC工程师似乎保留了手臂上那些炽热的脉冲激光，却拆掉氏族ATM，改在躯干中塞满自家特种导弹和重型AMS。

column1: With this 'Mech somebody has taken an old Zeus model and upgraded everything in it with clan tech. I'm not sure why someone would take the time to do this over starting with a clan 'Mech, but I am sure glad they did!
column2: 有人把一台旧Zeus型号机甲拿来，用氏族技术升级了所有部件。我不明白为什么不直接从氏族机甲开始，但我很高兴他们这么做了。

column1: A modification of the Charger BattleMech, the Cudgel 2A made its debut in the Solaris VII arenas in 3066. Built by Innovative Design Concepts with brutal melee combat in mind, the 2A comes fitted with Triple Strength Myomer and enough lasers to easily activate it.
column2: 这是 Charger 战斗机甲的改型，Cudgel 2A 于 3066 年首次亮相 Solaris VII 竞技场。它由 Innovative Design Concepts 打造，专为残酷的近战而设计，配备三倍强度肌电束和足够的激光器，可以轻松启动该系统。

column1: The 3064 2C variant of the Komodo removes the TAG unit from the 'Mech. The TAG designator is replaced with a C3 Slave unit. The 'Mech is capable of sharing targeting data with other friendly units, making the 'Mech and its lance mates extremely accurate.
column2: Komodo 的 3064 年 2C 型移除了机甲上的 TAG 单元，改为 C3 从属单元。该机甲能够与其他友军分享目标数据，使自身和同伴小队拥有极高的命中精度。

column1: The years following the Truce of Tukayyid saw an unprecedented era of close cooperation between the Federated Commonwealth and the Draconis Combine. Having contributed greatly to the Mauler's fame, the AFFC received many more through trade agreements. House Davion has a lasting fascination with autocannons, and invested heavily in advancing their technology in the 3050s, using the Mauler as one of its testbeds.
column2: Tukayyid 停战后的岁月见证了联邦国与龙马联邦之间前所未有的密切合作。AFFC 通过贸易协议获得了更多 Mauler，这对其声名远扬功不可没。达维翁家族一直痴迷于自动火炮，并在 3050 年代投入大量资源推进相关技术，把 Mauler 当作测试平台之一。

column1: A modification of the 2D, the 2D1 variant removes the Active Probe from the 2D model and replaces it with a C3 Slave unit, allowing it to share targeting data with friendly units.
column2: 这是 2D 型的改装版，2D1 移除了原型的主动探头，换成 C3 从属单元，使其能够与友军分享目标数据。

column1: If you overlook the heat management issues, this is a powerful variant for close quarters. As long as you keep it out of Long to Extreme ranges of firing it will likely be useful.
column2: 如果忽略散热管理问题，这是一款强大的近距离作战型号。只要避免在远距离至极远距离开火，它应该会很有用。

column1: Commander, I must say, the Hell's Horses have really outdone themselves with the Boreas Prime's Alternate Configurations. Configuration D in particular caught my eye - with its heavy emphasis on heat-based weaponry, it's sure to make a devastating impact on the battlefield. I can only imagine the amount of heat this mech will generate, but with the additional Laser Heat Sinks, it should be able to sustain itself in combat. It's certainly a bold move to sacrifice some of the mech's versatility in favor of pure firepower, but I have a feeling it will pay off in the right hands.
column2: 指挥官，我得说，地狱马氏族确实把 Boreas Prime 的替代配置做到了极致。D 配置尤其引人注目：它高度偏重热能武器，肯定能在战场上造成毁灭性影响。我只能想象这台机甲会产生多少热量，但额外的激光散热器应该足以让它维持战斗。牺牲部分多用途能力换取纯粹火力是大胆的选择，不过在合适的驾驶员手中，我感觉它会取得回报。

column1: Why? Just... why?? Sure, you can shoot 40 SRM missiles in one volley, but then what? Only carrying two ER Large Lasers besides the one-shots makes the use of this configuration quite low on a proper battlefield.
column2: 为什么？就……为什么？？当然，你可以一轮齐射 40 枚 SRM 导弹，但然后呢？除了那些一次性武器外只携带两门增程大型激光，使这种配置在真正的战场上用途极低。

column1: Based on the LMT-3C, this version of the 'Mech uses a mix of Clan weaponry and equipment.
column2: 该型号以 LMT-3C 为基础，采用了氏族武器和装备的混合配置。

column1: One of the latest variants of the Panther to be introduced, this combination of Clan and Inner Sphere tech presents an interesting design.
column2: 这是 Panther 最新推出的型号之一，将氏族与内层圈技术结合在一起，形成了有趣的设计。

column1: The Surtur is a fast medium BattleMech developed by the Hanseatic League as their first home built design. By 3120s, the League industrial/technology levels had achieved pre-Jihad level of technology. The governing Merchant Council decided it was time of the reason was pride in their nation's achievement, as indigenous design should be made. The Surtur is designed as a skirmisher, intended to get into close-quarters combat to render the enemies.
column2: Surtur 是汉萨同盟开发的快速中型战斗机甲，也是其首款自主设计。到 3120 年代，同盟的工业和技术水平已达到圣战前的水平。执政的商人委员会出于对国家成就的自豪，决定制造本土设计。Surtur 被设计成游击机甲，旨在迅速接近敌人进行近距离战斗。

column1: The Thunderbolt IIA is a one-off project to create a larger version of the 'Mech. Weighing in at 90 tons of total weight it really is just a larger and slower version of the original, and according to some MechWarriors worse.
column2: Thunderbolt IIA 是一次性项目，目的是制造更大型的该系列机甲。它总重 90 吨，实际上只是原版更大、更慢的版本，而且据一些机甲战士说，表现更糟。

column1: Built by Meridian Manufacturing, the Arbiter is nothing more than a light WorkMech crafted to look like a large and impressive Heavy Battlemech. A common refit to the Arbiter does it exchange the rifle for a 'real' Weapon.
column2: Arbiter 由 Meridian Manufacturing 制造，本质上只是披着大型重型战斗机甲外形的轻型工业机甲。常见的 Arbiter 改装会拆掉步枪，换上一件“真正的”武器。

column1: This Argus variant, introduced in 3074, is equipped with a then-experimental C3 Boosted Slave to cut through Jihad-era ECM. The weapons load has been tweaked as well, with an MML-7 replacing the LRM-10. The Machine Guns of the original have also been removed.
column2: 该 Argus 型号于 3074 年推出，配备当时仍属实验性质的 C3 增强从属单元，用来穿透圣战时代的 ECM。武器配置也经过调整，以 MML-7 替换 LRM-10，并移除了原型的机枪。

column1: Ah, the joys of weapon modularity. The cool thing about being a MechTech is that after a while you stop lookin' at weapons in terms of what they are, and start lookin' at them in terms of where they'll fit. And as far as the guys at Blue Shot were concerned — sure, an LB 20-X AC and a Gauss Rifle are the same thing.
column2: 啊，武器模块化的乐趣。作为机甲技师，干久了以后，你会不再从武器是什么的角度看它们，而是开始考虑它们能装在哪里。对 Blue Shot 的家伙来说——没错，LB 20-X AC 和高斯步枪就是一回事。

column1: A modification of the Charger BattleMech, the Cudgel 2A made its debut in the Solaris VII arenas in 3066. Built by Innovative Design Concepts with brutal melee combat in mind, the 2B comes fitted with Triple Strength Myomer and enough lasers to easily activate it.
column2: 这是 Charger 战斗机甲的改型，Cudgel 2A 于 3066 年首次亮相 Solaris VII 竞技场。它由 Innovative Design Concepts 打造，专为残酷的近战而设计，2B 型配备三倍强度肌电束和足够的激光器，可以轻松启动该系统。

column1: A simple field refit used during the Jihad, this version mounts a C3 slave unit in the torso and a second arm-mounted laser by removing the rear-firing model, while replacing the original autocannon with a light autocannon/5.
column2: 这是圣战期间使用的简单战地改装型：拆除后向射击型号，在躯干中安装 C3 从属单元和第二门手臂激光器，并将原有自动火炮换成轻型 AC/5。

column1: A mix of Inner Sphere and Clan tech, this 'Mech a lot of fun toys but does surprisingly bad on the battlefield. This is mainly due to its poor cooling, resulting in the MechWarriors piloting the -7X spending a lot of their attention managing the heat.
column2: 这台机甲混合了内层圈和氏族技术，拥有不少有趣的玩具，却在战场上的表现出人意料地差。主要问题是散热能力糟糕，驾驶 -7X 的机甲战士必须把大量注意力放在管理热量上。

column1: Boss, this is a Kuritan refit of the Grasshopper featuring an upgraded Endo-Steel chassis and a new heavy-duty gyro for increased stability. Its sporting an energy loadout featuring six Light PPCs, four of them even have attached capacitors to boost their damage.
column2: Boss，这是一台库里塔改装的 Grasshopper，采用升级的 Endo 钢底盘和新型重型陀螺仪来提高稳定性。它以能量武器为主，装备六门轻型 PPC，其中四门还加装了电容器以提升伤害。

column1: The Highlander IIC-3, introduced 3077 carries a HAG/20 with 4 tons of ammunition for long battlefield endurance and ECM Suite instead of the standard Gauss Rifle.
column2: Highlander IIC-3 于 3077 年推出，携带一门 HAG/20 和四吨弹药，具备长时间战场续航能力，并以 ECM 套件取代了标准高斯步枪。

column1: One of the more recent variants, using MMLs to try and be more flexible. 'Jack of all trades, master of none' probably applies here.
column2: 这是较新的型号之一，使用 MML 以提高灵活性。“样样通、样样松”大概正适合它。

column1: This one has been retrofitted with on land weapons instead of it's underwater original parts.
column2: 这台机甲用陆地武器替换了原本的水下部件。

column1: Built for House Liao the 5L attempted to make the reliable Marauder chassis work alongside their modernized Stealth Forces.
column2: 5L 为廖氏家族打造，试图让可靠的 Marauder 底盘与他们现代化的隐形部队协同作战。

column1: A Jihad era refit of the Merlin, the 1D removes the PPC and anti-infantry weapons of the 1C and replaces them with a Gauss Rifle and 2 tons of ammo.
column2: 这是 Merlin 在圣战时期的改装型，移除 1C 的 PPC 和反步兵武器，换成一把高斯步枪和两吨弹药。

column1: A well equipped recon unit with a lot of firepower, the 86 is a direct evolution of the original mongoose design.
column2: 86 型是一台装备精良、火力强大的侦察单位，是原始 Mongoose 设计的直接发展型。

column1: This Osteon configuration uses energy weapons. Three ER Large Lasers provide covering fire as the Osteon closes. For shorter ranges, the 'Mech carries two Improved Heavy Large Lasers. For close combat, the Osteon-B carries a Large Vibroblade.
column2: 这套 Osteon 配置使用能量武器。三门增程大型激光在 Osteon 接近目标时提供掩护火力；中距离则使用两门改进型重型大型激光；近战时，Osteon-B 携带一把大型振动刀。

column1: One of two 'cousins', the -12K and the -12K2, they are fairly similar but different enough to have different combat profiles.
column2: -12K 与 -12K2 是两台“表亲”型号，整体相当相似，但差异足以形成不同的战斗定位。

column1: The Procyon is the first ProtoMech designed and built by Clan Coyote. Procyon 4 Mounts a Streak SRM-3 launcher and Machine Gun in place of the standard ER lasers.
column2: Procyon 是氏族郊狼设计并制造的第一种原型机甲。Procyon 4 用一具 Streak SRM-3 发射器和一挺机枪替换了标准增程激光器。

column1: This configuration carries a Nova CEWS and Light TAG. Each arm carries three Improved Heavy Small Lasers, while each side torso carries an iATM 12 with two tons of ammunition. Seventeen double heat sinks keep it cool.
column2: 该配置携带 Nova CEWS 和轻型 TAG。每条手臂装有三门改进型重型小型激光，每侧躯干装有一具 iATM-12 和两吨弹药。17 个双重散热器负责保持低温。

column1: Boss, these Shadow Hawk IICs are a sleek redesign of the classic Shadow Hawk. They are lighter and faster than the original but still manage to pack a similar punch
column2: Boss，这些 Shadow Hawk IIC 是经典 Shadow Hawk 的流线型重设计。它们比原版更轻、更快，同时仍能保持相近的火力。

column1: Introduced during the Jihad, the Strider G configuration carries a pair of ER Small Lasers in the torso to defend against hostile infantry. The main striking power comes from an MML-7 launcher in each arm. This configuration carries a ton of LRM and SRM ammunition for the MMLs.
column2: G 配置于圣战期间推出，在躯干中装有一对增程小型激光，用于防御敌方步兵。主要打击力来自每条手臂中的一具 MML-7 发射器；该配置为 MML 携带一吨 LRM 和 SRM 弹药。

column1: The Temax Cat Ninjabolt is a heavy class of BattleMech which, over time, was repaired with odd-'Mech parts, which resulted in it becoming an Experimental FrankenMech. It was cobbled together from a collection of parts over the years by Solaris VII MechWarrior Larry Allen Barttelbort.
column2: Temax Cat Ninjabolt 是一种重型战斗机甲，多年来不断用奇怪的机甲部件修理，最终成为实验性的 FrankenMech。Solaris VII 机甲战士 Larry Allen Barttelbort 多年来用各种部件将它拼凑起来。

column1: The Thanatos-8S has been refit with an Emergency Coolant System and Prototype DHS, sporting both a Mortar and MML with a wide variety of ammo is it able to stay longer in the fight and dominate the engagement.
column2: Thanatos-8S 加装了应急冷却系统和原型双重散热器，同时配备迫击炮和 MML。多种弹药让它能够在战斗中坚持更久并掌控交战。

column1: The Triton was designed by Clan Goliath Scorpion for their Seekers. This version carries a single ER Micro Laser in the torso and a Heavy Small Laser on each arm.
column2: Triton 由大角蝎氏族为其探索者设计。该版本在躯干中携带一门增程微型激光，双臂各装一门重型小型激光。

column1: Fast mech with a seriously heavy hit when that capacitor is fully applied. Excellent at surprise attacks, just lacks the jump jets to be a good flanker.
column2: 这是一台速度很快的机甲，电容器完全充能时能打出极重的伤害。它非常适合突袭，只是没有跳跃喷射器，难以担任侧翼机甲。

column1: The difference towards the 7M is small, the Heavy PPC has slightly shorter range and deals a bit less damage than the Large Lasers, but in turn generates less heat.
column2: 与 7M 型相比差异很小：重型 PPC 的射程略短，伤害也比大型激光低一些，但产生的热量更少。

column1: This particular Zeus model has seen some rather advanced Wobbie upgrades and sports some serious firepower while still maintaining the traditional speed they are known for.
column2: 这台 Zeus 型号接受了相当先进的沃比升级，仍保持其一贯的速度，同时拥有强大的火力。

column1: This one is tricked out with everything a ComStar Problem fixer could possibly want.
column2: 这台机甲装满了 ComStar 问题解决专家可能想要的一切设备。

column1: A Kuritan variant of the classic Catapult, the Catapult K6 debuted in the Dark Ages. Armed with a pair of ELRM-15’s and 4 ER Small Lasers, the design is designed to engage and destroy enemies at extreme range.
column2: 这是经典 Catapult 的库里塔变体，K6 型在黑暗时代首次亮相。它装备两具 ELRM-15 和四门增程小型激光，专门用于在极远距离交战并摧毁敌人。

column1: I have been finding R model parts all over the galaxy lately. It is no wonder the pirates have managed to scrape one together and make it a melee monster.
column2: 我最近在整个银河系到处发现 R 型部件。难怪海盗能拼出一台，还把它变成近战怪物。

column1: Fast enough to easily flank the opponent, quickly followed by hitting them dead-on from the side with all those weapons. I drove one of these myself once, before I took a shrapnel to the knee and had to become an engineer.
column2: 它的速度足以轻松绕到对手侧翼，然后用全部武器从侧面迅速命中。我曾经亲自驾驶过一台，直到膝盖被弹片击中，只好改行当工程师。

column1: The Dark Crow is a Clan Snow Raven developed Second Line BattleMech, which was produced only at its Inner Sphere facilities in the Outworlds Alliance after the Jihad. Named after a strange cave-dwelling bird found on Dante, the 'Mech has proven to be a popular design among Second Line troops. This variant is more of a mobile anti-aircraft platform.
column2: Dark Crow 是雪鸦氏族开发的二线战斗机甲，圣战后仅在外域联盟的内层圈设施生产。它以 Dante 上发现的一种奇怪穴居鸟类命名，已成为二线部队中广受欢迎的设计。这一型号更像是一台机动防空平台。

column1: The Deimos was developed by the Snow Raven Clan and the Mech was first introduced during the middle of the 3060s, allegedly on the Kerensky Cluster world of Lum. However, Inner Sphere intelligence agencies stopped hearing rumors about the 'Mech during the Jihad and it faded from memory. In 3085, the Snow Ravens revealed the existence of the Deimos to the Inner Sphere. It is considered as the pride of the Clan making at least one assigned to every touman. The D variant was introduced during the Dark Age era in 3119.
column2: Deimos 由雪鸦氏族开发，最初据称于 3060 年代中期在 Kerensky 星群的 Lum 世界首次亮相。然而，内层圈情报机构在圣战期间不再听到有关它的消息，它逐渐被遗忘。3085 年，雪鸦氏族向内层圈公开了 Deimos 的存在。它被视为该氏族的骄傲，几乎每支 Touman 都会配备至少一台。D 型于黑暗时代 3119 年推出。

column1: This thing can really soar. If you ever get bored inside it during patrol duty, just found a local mountain top and jump on top of it. Just don't blame me when you come falling down due to excessive heat.
column2: 这东西真的能飞得很高。如果巡逻时在里面感到无聊，就找座当地山峰跳上去吧。只是别在因过热掉下来时怪我。

column1: Taking inspiration from the original Grasshopper 5H, the 8K is a Dark Age redesign of the Grasshopper that reinvents it as a long ranged skirmisher and raider. Armed with 4 LPPC’s and an ER Large Laser, the 8K retains the 5H’s head mounted LRM-5; albeit with the inclusion of CAE II to protect the ammo bay.
column2: 8K 型从原始 Grasshopper 5H 汲取灵感，是黑暗时代对 Grasshopper 的重新设计，将其改造成远程游击和突袭机甲。它装备四门轻型 PPC 和一门增程大型激光，同时保留 5H 型安装在头部的 LRM-5，并加入 CASE II 保护弹药舱。

column1: While it has been noted that its MechWarriors have it customized for their purposes, this design's original weapons layout consisted of two Series 6b Extended Range Large Lasers and two Type OVR-V LB 2-X ACs mounted in its shortened arms actuators. In addition to these ranged weapons systems, engineers would go on to reinforce the Gyrfalcon's legs. This is a nod to their touman changing its attitude towards the use of physical attacks, namely using Death from Above maneuver.
column2: 虽然机甲战士常常会根据自身用途定制它的配置，但该设计最初的武器布局是两门 6b 系列增程大型激光，以及两门安装在缩短手臂驱动器上的 OVR-V 型 LB 2-X AC。除了这些远程武器，工程师还强化了 Gyrfalcon 的腿部。这体现了其 Touman 对物理攻击态度的转变，尤其是采用从天而降的死亡机动。

column1: If you need to turn the lights out on a Mech, the Icarus II-2R would be a good choice to use. It is moderately fast and sports two TSEMP Cannons capable of doing terrible things to a Mech.
column2: 如果你需要让一台机甲熄灯，Icarus II-2R 是不错的选择。它速度适中，装备两门 TSEMP 炮，足以对机甲造成可怕的后果。

column1: A very advanced Locust, the IIC 9 uses the latest Clan tech to attempt to move beyond just the scout role.
column2: 这是一台极其先进的 Locust，IIC 9 使用最新氏族技术，试图摆脱单纯侦察机甲的定位。

column1: This thing is fast and packs a punch! Good luck keeping up with it when the Supercharge is enabled, and when it stops...hide!
column2: 这东西速度很快，火力也很猛！启用 Supercharge 后祝你能跟上它；而当它停下来时——快躲起来！

column1: It has some interesting tech, but mostly it is a stock Penetrator. Not sure how useful it would be for us, maybe just strip the clan tech and sell the chassis?
column2: 它有一些有趣的技术，但总体上仍是标准 Penetrator。我们不确定它对我们有多大用处，也许拆掉氏族技术、卖掉底盘更合适？

column1: The Stalking Spider II is a Clan Medium BattleMech designed and produced by Clan Sea Fox at its Manufacturing Plant SFF-TU1 on Tukayyid. Produced since the dawn of the thirty-second century, the Stalking Spider II was a result of the merchant Clan’s desire to bring more revenue into its coffers. The Clan redesigned the original Stalking Spider Quad 'Mech with new innovations, but these "innovations" began being problematic for its pilots, due to a unique turret design. It proved to be popular with Inner Sphere second-line defense units, despite its shortcomings.
column2: Stalking Spider II 是氏族中型战斗机甲，由海狐氏族在 Tukayyid 的 SFF-TU1 制造厂设计并生产。自三十二世纪初开始生产，它源于商人氏族增加收入的愿望。氏族用新技术重设计了原始的四足 Stalking Spider，但这些“创新”因独特炮塔设计给驾驶员带来问题。尽管存在缺陷，它仍受到内层圈二线防御部队欢迎。

column1: The Horses have supplemented their generalist and missile boat Svartalfas with a close-combat variant dropping the Streak missiles to mount more chemical lasers. Accordingly, it is slightly less sluggish once airborne.
column2: 地狱马氏族用近战型号补充了通用型和导弹艇型 Svartalfa，拆除 Streak 导弹并安装更多化学激光。因此它在空中飞行时稍微没那么迟缓。

column1: Yeah Boss, why do you keep bringing me junk, like any 'Cockroach' will this thing never die....
column2: 没错，Boss，你为什么总给我带垃圾？这东西就像“蟑螂”一样，怎么都死不了……

column1: Taking inspiration from the R20 series of mechs, this urban mech was designed from the ground up; to be a cheap and nasty ambusher aimed at the mercenary market. The combination of stealth armour and rockets allow it to savage targets and withdraw.
column2: 这台城市机甲从 R20 系列汲取灵感，从头设计成面向佣兵市场的廉价恶毒伏击者。隐形装甲与火箭的组合让它能够重创目标后迅速撤离。

column1: When Clan Coyote prepared to return to the Inner Sphere, they committed to a do-or-die campaign: either secure territory or be broken. The Boyyi - meaning roadrunner in Terran Native American Zuni - reflects this harsh philosophy. Its design is resource-intensive and limited in numbers, created to serve as a superior recon presence on enemy worlds. This strategy and other invasion policies have left the Coyotes’ Clan Homeworld territories severely depleted of resources.
column2: 氏族郊狼准备返回内层圈时，决定展开一场不成功便成仁的战役：要么夺取领土，要么彻底覆灭。Boyyi 在特兰原住民 Zuni 语中意为“走鹃”，体现了这种严酷理念。它设计上消耗大量资源、数量有限，用于在敌方世界提供优秀侦察力量。这种战略和其他入侵政策使郊狼氏族家园的资源严重枯竭。

column1: The Varhunter is an ultralight urban support 'Mech developed by the DCMS at the start of the Jihad but shelved until the Dark Age. Designed for low cost and easy maintenance, it uses standard components and minimal advanced tech. Visually, the Varhunter resembles a blend of the Hussar and Crab, with clawed limbs and dorsal-mounted lasers. Its unfamiliar silhouette, combined with hit-and-run tactics, initially confused enemy targeting systems during early deployments, making it difficult to identify and counter effectively.
column2: Varhunter 是 DCMS 在圣战初期开发、直到黑暗时代才重新启用的超轻型城市支援机甲。它以低成本和易维护为目标，使用标准部件和极少的先进技术。外形上类似 Hussar 与 Crab 的混合体，拥有爪状肢体和背部安装的激光器。陌生的轮廓配合袭扰战术，使其在早期部署中扰乱了敌方瞄准系统，难以被有效识别和反制。

column1: This is a custom Clint mech of a Solaris Gladiator, who shared the name with his favorite mech. The pilot supposedly called Clint Eastwood was well known by fans and his enemies, that after making gaping holes with his customized weaponry in your mech, he likes to shout in all comms "Do you feel lucky, punk? Do ya??!.
column2: 这是 Solaris 角斗士定制的 Clint 机甲，驾驶员与自己最喜欢的机甲同名。据说名叫 Clint Eastwood 的驾驶员在粉丝和敌人中都很有名；他用定制武器在敌方机甲上打出巨大缺口后，总会在所有通讯频道大喊：“你觉得自己走运吗，混蛋？嗯？！”

column1: Boss... This mech is based on Seraph, however this version is fully packed with experimental technologies. I don't know where you got it, but I smell troubles.
column2: Boss……这台机甲基于 Seraph，但这个版本塞满了实验技术。我不知道你从哪弄来的，但我闻到了麻烦的味道。

column1: The Little Brother comes from the Parallax Corporation, built to accompany its larger counterpart the Big Brother onto the field. It carries nothing but combat equipment, no superfluous industrial gear weighing it down, making it purpose built despite its IndustrialMech roots. It holds up fine against primitive combat vehicles and infantry but stands little chance against an actual BattleMech, and its speed leaves it wanting once drawn into open terrain.
column2: Little Brother 来自 Parallax Corporation，设计用来伴随更大的 Big Brother 上战场。它只携带战斗设备，没有多余的工业装备拖累重量，因此尽管源自工业机甲，仍是专门的战斗平台。它应付原始战斗车辆和步兵还算不错，但面对真正的战斗机甲机会渺茫，一旦进入开阔地形，速度不足的问题就会暴露。

column1: This one's a testbed, built by House Liao to see how the snub-nose PPC performs. Simple design, no frills beyond the cannons and the heat sinks needed to run them. Project got canned inside a decade, most parts scavenged before the Amaris war even started.
column2: 这是测试平台，由廖氏家族制造，用来检验短管 PPC 的性能。设计简单，除了火炮和运行所需的散热器外没有多余装置。项目在十年内被取消，大多数部件在阿玛瑞战争开始前就已被拆作备件。

column1: The Federated Commonwealth rejected this one for being too slow and underarmored for its weight, which tells you something about how they think. The Taurian Concordat saw it differently, and honestly I side with them. Three Gauss Rifles on one frame is not something you just walk away from. Production line got wrecked in the Jihad and the design nearly vanished entirely. Finding one of these still operational is like finding a fossil that can still bite.
column2: 联邦国拒绝了这款机甲，认为以其重量而言速度太慢、装甲太薄，这能说明他们的想法。陶瑞安协约国却有不同看法，我老实说站在他们这边。一台机体上装三把高斯步枪，不是你能轻易忽视的火力。生产线在圣战中被摧毁，这种设计几乎完全消失。找到一台仍能运行的，就像发现一块还会咬人的化石。

column1: Kong Interstellar built these for asteroid mining out of the Federated Commonwealth originally but they spread everywhere pretty fast. You see them all over the Periphery because the parts are cheap and they just don't quit. Not a combat machine by any stretch but those Piledrivers have a way of changing a pirate's mind real quick. Good salvage honestly.
column2: Kong Interstellar 最初为联邦国制造这些设备用于小行星采矿，但它们很快传播到各处。你在边疆到处都能看到它们，因为零件便宜，而且耐用得惊人。它无论如何都算不上战斗机器，但那些 Piledriver 能迅速改变海盗的想法。说实话，是很好的回收品。

column1: General Motors saw the Clans rebuild the Fire Wasp and decided the Inner Sphere needed its own answer. Ten tons heavier, proper long-range weapons, Heavy Flamers instead of standard ones, and a Retractable Blade tucked into the right arm. It became one of the most common medium mechs of its era, which tells you something. The Magistracy Highlanders ran these too. Star Corporal Luna Rhodes fought in one right up until Cate's Hold in 3101. That is a name worth remembering.
column2: 通用汽车看到氏族重建 Fire Wasp 后，决定让内层圈拥有自己的回应。它重十吨，配备真正的远程武器，用重型火焰喷射器替换标准型号，并在右臂藏有一把伸缩刀。它成为那个时代最常见的中型机甲之一，这本身就说明了问题。治安官高地人也驾驶过它。Star Corporal Luna Rhodes 一直驾驶此型号战斗到 3101 年 Cate's Hold 战役。这个名字值得记住。

column1: Hellespont named this one after a MechWarrior operating in Capellan space, which tells you what kind of machine it was meant to be. The Partial Wing came from Jade Falcon hardware, the MML from a mercenary company. Maggie Faraday herself raided one in 3069 and ran it for decades. After the Jihad the CCAF sold a limited number to mercenaries working with the Magistracy. Whatever you paid for this one, it was worth it.
column2: Hellespont 以一名在卡佩兰空间活动的机甲战士命名这台机甲，这已经说明了它的用途。部分机翼来自 Jade Falcon 的装备，MML 则来自一家佣兵公司。Maggie Faraday 本人于 3069 年突袭缴获一台，并驾驶了数十年。圣战后，CCAF 向与治安官合作的佣兵出售了少量该型号。无论你为它付了多少钱，都物有所值。

column1: The Valedictus is a Detroit Consolidated design that came out of the 32nd century MAF procurement pipeline, built at a time when the Magistracy was watching the Wolf Empire consolidate power and needed assault-weight hardware that could handle a broad range of battlefield problems rather than excel at just one thing. The Bombast Laser never found wide adoption because it demands more from a pilot than most weapons do, but Detroit Consolidated bet on Canopian MechWarriors being good enough to use it properly. From what the Ebon Magistrate did with it in Marian Hegemony raids, that bet paid off.
column2: Valedictus 是 Detroit Consolidated 的设计，源自三十二世纪 MAF 采购体系。当时治安官正眼看狼帝国巩固势力，需要的是能处理广泛战场问题的突击级装备，而不是只擅长某一件事。Bombast 激光对驾驶员的要求高于大多数武器，因此始终没有广泛采用；但 Detroit Consolidated 认为卡诺普斯机甲战士足够优秀，能够正确使用它。从 Ebon Magistrate 在马里安霸权突袭中的表现来看，这场押注成功了。

column1: General Systems built exactly one of these right before the Amaris Civil War. SLDF wanted the biggest mech ever made and they wanted it to run without a pilot. That Drone Control System ate twenty tons and the whole project got written off as a failure. Then some poor mercenary scavengers dug it up in 3025 on an icy world and accidentally switched it back on. Took out everything in sight until someone found the control center and shut it down for good. After that they same group of mercenary buffoons ripped the Drone Control System out and converted it to manual controls, can't say it seemed worth the effort looking at it now.
column2: General Systems 在阿玛瑞内战前夕制造了唯一一台这样的机器。SLDF 想要史上最大的机甲，并且希望它无需驾驶员即可运行。无人机控制系统占用了 20 吨重量，整个项目随后被判定为失败。3025 年，一群可怜的佣兵拾荒者在冰封世界挖出了它，并意外重新启动。它摧毁视线内的一切，直到有人找到控制中心并永久关闭。后来同一群佣兵蠢货拆除了无人机控制系统，改成手动操纵；看现在的结果，我不能说这番努力值得。

column1: After the success of the Arbiter Meridian Manufacturing began producing a more limited and advanced design, that actually does carry a big scary gun. Still armored with nothing more then Paper and Wishes, is it able to destroy most targets within a single Salvo.
column2: Arbiter 成功后，Meridian Manufacturing 开始生产更少量、更先进的设计，终于装上了一门真正可怕的大炮。它的装甲仍然只相当于纸张和愿望，却能在一次齐射内摧毁大多数目标。

column1: Blackjacks are supposed to be solid, well-rounded 'Mechs for their tonnage. This... isn't.
column2: 按吨位来说，Blackjack 本应是坚固、均衡的机甲。这台……不是。

column1: I think whatever pirate owned this thing had a duel go wrong with a missile carrier or something, because they were clearly terrified of missiles. It's got half a dozen different AMS throughout the mech, and I think they even managed to turn the volume up on the missile lock warning sound in a way that I don't know if I can undo.
column2: 我觉得这台机甲的海盗主人曾和导弹载体决斗失败之类的，因为他显然对导弹极度恐惧。整台机甲到处装了六七套 AMS，我甚至怀疑他们把导弹锁定警报的音量也调高了，而且我不知道能不能调回去。

column1: A Pirate special Grasshopper. This one had several copies of the Capellan Death Commandos training manual stashed in the cockpit, and I think they were convinced that they were some ninja mechwarrior, especially considering the stealth systems. How they thought a heavy mech with jumpjets was going to be stealthy is beyond me.
column2: 一台海盗专属 Grasshopper。这台机甲的驾驶舱里藏着好几份卡佩兰死亡突击队训练手册，我觉得他们确信自己是忍者机甲战士，尤其考虑到它的隐形系统。至于他们怎么认为一台带跳跃喷射器的重型机甲能隐形，我就想不通了。

column1: When Pirates find something New They always take advantage of it.Shortly after recovering a drone's carcus they shoved it into one of their most beloved designs.
column2: 海盗一旦发现新东西，总会想办法利用。刚回收一台无人机残骸，他们就把它塞进自己最喜欢的设计之一。

column1: Well Boss, this is a Razorback, but these junkers replaced most of its Parts to Support its Flamers. Theres a note saying 'Be wary what you wish for'.
column2: 没错，Boss，这是一台 Razorback，但这些破烂工匠替换了它的大部分部件，以支援火焰喷射器。上面还有一张字条：“小心你所祈求的东西。”

column1: Don't let the stubby UM-R666 'Urbie' fool you, it may look like a walking trash can, but it is a Devil Worshiping Monster.
column2: 别被短粗的 UM-R666 “Urbie” 骗了。它看起来像会走路的垃圾桶，但其实是崇拜恶魔的怪物。

column1: Vindicator P's are basically ramshackle pieces of barely working scrap metal, typically encountered among pirates but one never knows how bad someone's mechtech really is.
column2: Vindicator P 基本都是勉强能运行的破铜烂铁，通常在海盗手中出现，但谁知道某人的机甲技师水平到底有多糟。

column1: Boss, I have no idea how pirates managed to acquire one of the most advanced prototype series 'Mechs in existance. They broke and "fixed" all the weapons but the electronics still seem to be in good shape!
column2: Boss，我完全不知道海盗怎么弄到一台最先进的原型系列机甲。他们把所有武器都拆坏又“修好”了，但电子设备似乎仍然工作良好！

column1: Well. Somebody's definitely been rooting around in here long before we were. If you were under the impression this was a swanky Clanner OmniMech, you're fresh outta luck, Boss. This here is a grade-A FrankenMech job.
column2: 嗯，肯定有人在我们之前很久就翻过这里。如果你以为这是体面的氏族全向机甲，那就想多了，Boss。这是货真价实的顶级 FrankenMech 改装。

column1: Well, this 'Mech works. I don't like that it works, but it does. I'm not crazy enough to try and reverse all the hack-jobs that were done to make this into a BattleMech instead of an OmniMech, so this is as good as you'll get, Boss.
column2: 这台机甲还能工作。我不喜欢它能工作，但事实就是如此。我可没疯到想逆向修复他们为了把全向机甲改成战斗机甲而做的所有黑客式改装，所以 Boss，这已经是你能得到的最好结果。

column1: Boss, I really don't know what to say about this thing.  Basically some junkhead rigged the weapons up so they could fire nearly any missile or AC10 caliber round imaginable and it was stuffed full of said ammo. I'll try and put this thing back together but it doesn't look good.
column2: Boss，我真不知道该怎么说。这东西基本上是某个废物把武器改装成可以发射几乎所有想得到的导弹或 AC/10 口径炮弹，然后又把机体塞满了这些弹药。我会试着把它重新拼好，但情况看起来不妙。

column1: The end result of a very wealthy pirate deciding to see how many shells he could hurl downrange per second from a single mech. The answer was ''This many''.
column2: 一个极其富有的海盗想看看单台机甲每秒能向远处投掷多少炮弹，于是造出了这个结果。答案是：“就这么多。”

column1: After weathering many an assault by Clan Warriors, RISC Engineers have refit these Warhounds based upon the versatile Stormcrow. Carrying a Heavy Missile payload, it excells as a fast striker and fire support 'mech.
column2: RISC 工程师在多次遭受氏族战士攻击后，以灵活的 Stormcrow 为基础改装了这些 Warhound。它携带重型导弹载荷，既是快速突击者，也是优秀的火力支援机甲。

column1: Well, if you ever wanted to see a mech burst into flames despite having a fully functioning cooling system, then point this thing at them. Those "double ACs" are a lot less flexable than UACs, but their one upside is that they can use normal AC rounds, which in this case means inferno rounds. Just be careful with letting the newbie pilots in the cockpit, since a "misfire" will damage those guns.
column2: 如果你想看一台机甲即使冷却系统完全正常也能烧成火球，就把这东西对准目标。那些“双重 AC”远不如 UAC 灵活，但唯一的优点是能使用普通 AC 炮弹——在本例中就是 Inferno 弹。让新手驾驶员进驾驶舱时要小心，因为一次“哑火”就会损坏这些火炮。

column1: I'm not sure I've ever seen an anti-missile mech take it this far. A huge amount of its tonnage is dedicated to anti-missile warheads. While it does produce an excellent defence, it's also limited by ammunition in a way that laser systems aren't, so a good LRM barrage is always going to win that fight at the end of the day. Decent backup weaponry though, in the form of those deadfire SRMs.
column2: 我不确定自己是否见过把反导机甲做到这种程度的。它大量吨位都投入了反导弹战斗部。虽然防御效果出色，但它像激光系统一样受弹药限制，所以到最后，一轮优秀的 LRM 齐射总能赢得对决。不过备用武器还不错，比如那些死火 SRM。

column1: This commando is surprisingly hardy for how fast it is. The shotgun is a nice touch, but be careful about trying to overuse that TSM, since it's got 'Quicsell Quality' stamped all over it. Oh, and be careful at full speed, this thing is rather unsteady.
column2: 这台突击队机甲以如此高的速度而言出奇地坚固。霰弹枪是不错的点子，但要小心别过度使用 TSM，因为机体到处都盖着“Quicsell 品质”的印章。还有，全速行驶时要当心，这东西相当不稳定。

column1: This is a tough light mech, true. The problem is the weaponry. The whole mech has less than 30 missile tubes and no other weapons. The so called self repair capabilites are mostly a gimick. It's like watching paint dry when damage happens, and it's only really useful for scratch damage from infantry weapons and the like.
column2: 这是一台坚固的轻型机甲，确实如此。问题在于武器：整台机甲不到 30 个导弹管，而且没有其他武器。所谓的自我修复能力大多只是噱头，受损时修复速度像看油漆变干，真正只对步兵武器造成的轻微擦伤有用。

column1: An odd one. Normally, light mechs mounting a full PPC try to stay out of the fight and snipe from afar. This mech is designed to wail on the enemy with it's fists while unloading fire on them. Not sure I'd reccomend it, personally, seeing as it is still a light mech, but it's up to you.
column2: 很奇怪的一台机甲。通常装备完整 PPC 的轻型机甲会远离战斗，从远处狙击；这台却设计成一边用拳头痛击敌人，一边倾泻火力。我个人不太推荐，毕竟它仍是轻型机甲，但由你决定。

column1: For a knockoff attempt at a Raven, this mech actually has decent E-war capabilities. The scanning is very powerful, albeit not very detailed, and the EWS shielding is surprisingly good, albeit very range limited. Neat PPC though.
column2: 这是一台仿制 Raven 的尝试，却拥有不错的电子战能力。扫描功能非常强大，虽然细节不足；EWS 屏蔽也出人意料地好，不过有效范围很有限。PPC 倒是挺漂亮。

column1: This rather unique Bushwacker seems to have been made to order by a rather obsessive RISC Engineer, sporting not only upgrades to its Electronics and Actuators, but firepower on par with far Heavier Mech's.
column2: 这台相当独特的 Bushwacker 似乎是由一名执着的 RISC 工程师定制打造的，不仅升级了电子设备和驱动器，火力也达到了远重于它的机甲水平。

column1: A RISC redesign of the SLDF Helepolis, with the goal of creating a Siege unit that can defend itself and actively engage a Enemy Line.
column2: 这是 RISC 对 SLDF Helepolis 的重新设计，目标是制造一台能够自我防御并主动与敌方战线交战的攻城单位。

column1: Created in collaboration with scientists from the former NAIS, this variant carries upgraded rotary autocannons.
column2: 该型号由前 NAIS 的科学家参与合作开发，携带升级型转管自动炮。

column1: A RISC engineered Refit of the Old Vindicator designed to carry 2 Light PPC's with Twin-Linked Capacitors alongside a Experimental MML10 this design offers superior scouting capabilities.
column2: 这是 RISC 工程改装的老式 Vindicator，装备两门带双联电容器的轻型 PPC，并搭载实验型 MML-10，具备更强的侦察能力。

column1: I'm not entirely sure what to make of this, Boss. If it wasn't for the fact this thing apparently saw real combat, I'd've just said it was a dummy 'Mech used in a lab to test that weapons at least integrated. Lasers? Clan. Heat Sinks? Not Clan. The missiles? It feels like they're somewhere in between. It's weird.
column2: 我不太确定该怎么评价它，Boss。如果不是因为它显然参加过实战，我会说这只是实验室里用来测试武器是否能集成的样机。激光器？氏族的。散热器？不是氏族的。导弹？感觉介于两者之间。真奇怪。

column1: Improved Jumpjets and a Booster Pack make this Jenner Variant a Formidable Foe, being able to Jump and Run wherever it wants. The ReEngineered Lasers also do Quite a lot of Work, together with the Punch of the MRM10 its a Fearsome Armament. 14 Double Heatsinks and Cooling Jackets in the Arms also make it Cooler than Usually. A Very nice Piece of Tech, Boss.
column2: 改进型跳跃喷射器和助推包让这款 Jenner 变体成为可怕的敌人，能够随心所欲地跳跃和奔跑。重构激光器也相当卖力，再加上 MRM-10 的拳头般打击，武器非常凶猛。14 个双重散热器和安装在手臂中的冷却套让它比通常型号凉爽得多。Boss，这是一件非常漂亮的技术。

column1: Found some cobwebs while working through the internals of this one, boss. Looks like we scored ourselves an old piece of Star League junk. It's solid - perhaps except for the prototype autocannon model - but boy is it running light on ammo.
column2: Boss，我在检查这台机甲内部时发现了一些蜘蛛网。看来我们捞到了一件古老的星盟废品。整体很扎实——也许原型自动火炮除外——但它的弹药少得可怜。

column1: This is a pretty interesting find, boss. Looks like an old SLDF custom, but with some kind of early Clan prototypes integrated. With the way this thing is set up for stealth, as long as you can keep it out of direct line of sight, the enemy'll never even know it's there.
column2: 这是个很有意思的发现，Boss。看起来像是旧 SLDF 定制机，但整合了某种早期氏族原型技术。它的隐形配置非常彻底，只要避免进入敌人的直接视线，对方甚至不会知道它在那里。

column1: Boss, if we have an accidental discharge of those lasers in the bay, I think they'd melt a hole all the way to the galley. Let's not do that.
column2: Boss，如果那些激光在机库里走火，我觉得它们能直接熔穿一个洞，直到船员餐厅。我们可千万别这么做。

column1: This is a strange one, boss. It's got that CLPS for stealth but it can also run and jump like the devil. This thing would be hell to track down.
column2: 这台很奇怪，Boss。它有 CLPS 用于隐形，却还能像恶魔一样奔跑和跳跃。追捕这东西会是噩梦。

column1: The 005 King Crab is an upgraded version of the 000 model introduced in 3062. The autocannons have been upgraded to LB-X Autocannon/20s and the large laser has been upgraded to an ER Large Laser. The LRM-15 has been completely removed from the ‘Mech and replaced with two Streak SRM-4s. The final upgrade is the inclusion of an improved C3 computer to allow the King Crab to work in concert with up to five other units sharing targeting telemetry.
column2: 005 型 King Crab 是 3062 年推出的 000 型升级版。自动火炮升级为 LB-X 自动火炮/20，大型激光器升级为增程大型激光器。LRM-15 被从机甲上完全拆除，换成两具 Streak SRM-4。最后的升级是加装改进型 C3 计算机，使 King Crab 能与最多五个共享目标遥测数据的单位协同作战。

column1: For a scout this locust does the job with the benefit of a quick mission kill on other lights in it's weight bracket. We can work with it boss.
column2: 作为侦察机，这台 Locust 很称职，还能迅速击杀同吨位级别的其他轻型机甲。我们可以用它，老大。

column1: After the Penetrator PTR-4D of Major General Archer Christifori, known as the leader of militia group Archer's Avengers, was heavily damage during intense fighting against six Jaguar 'Mechs on its own, Archer eventually rebuilt the 'Mech and took the chance to customize it to his own preferences.
column2: Archer Christifori 少将是民兵组织 Archer's Avengers 的领袖。其 Penetrator PTR-4D 在独自与六台 Jaguar 机甲激战时严重受损，Archer 最终重建了机体，并趁机按个人偏好进行了定制。

column1: A Uziel salvaged an refitted by the Confederacy Capella to be fielded among their Stealth and Recon Units.
column2: 一台被卡佩兰联盟回收并改装、用于隐形和侦察部队的 Uziel。

column1: This 'Mech seems to have an old fashioned phone booth mounted in the cockpit that says "Phone Home".
column2: 这台机甲的驾驶舱里似乎装着一间老式电话亭，上面写着“打电话回家”。

column1: Based upon the rare 10B Variant was this Centurions iconic Shield Arm replaced with an 'Active Shield' that incorporates both an APDS and Blue Shield Dampener alongside the finest Information Warfare equipment money can buy.
column2: 该 Centurion 基于罕见的 10B 型，标志性的盾臂被替换为“主动盾”，集成 APDS 和 Blue Shield Dampener，并配备金钱能买到的最先进信息战设备。

column1: The customized Merlin C of Knight-Errant Jones of Clan Sea Fox. The 'Mech is named after his very first personal BattleMech, a Thor II named 'Tremor'. It is still uncertain if the Merlin is just a temporary replacement while his Thor II is getting repairs, or if it is a more permanent switch of prefered BattleMech to pilot.
column2: Sea Fox 氏族 Knight-Errant Jones 定制的 Merlin C。机甲以他人生中第一台私人 BattleMech 命名，那是一台名为“Tremor”的 Thor II。目前尚不确定 Merlin 只是 Thor II 维修期间的临时替代品，还是他永久更换了偏好的驾驶机甲。

column1: The Thresher Mk II is a Heavy Clan BattleMech designed as a skirmisher by Clan Sea Fox. This is a remodeled/refitted version of the venerable Thresher. The Thresher Mk II came about when a number of these 'Mechs were produced during the Dark Age Era and Clan Sea Fox Merchants were unable to sell them. Negotiations with Clan Wolf Khan Alaric Ward paved the way toward a sale, but only if the 'Mechs were refitted to Clan Wolf's specifications, which included arm actuators that the original design never featured.
column2: Thresher Mk II 是 Sea Fox 氏族设计的重型氏族 BattleMech，定位为游击机。它是老牌 Thresher 的重制／改装型。黑暗时代期间，Sea Fox 商人生产了多台 Thresher Mk II 却无法销售；与 Wolf 氏族可汗 Alaric Ward 的谈判促成了交易，但前提是按 Wolf 氏族规格重新改装，包括原始设计没有的手臂驱动器。

column1: This field-expedient refit was introduced to fight off the Draconis Combine during their early 32nd century invasion of the Draconis March. All the weapons have been removed and replaced with a Large Re-engineered Laser, ER Flamers, and two Magshots. The laser and flamers are on one arm, while the Magshots are on the opposite arm.
column2: 这套战场应急改装用于抵御 32 世纪初 Draconis March 遭受的 Draconis Combine 入侵。所有武器都被拆除，换成一门大型重构激光器、增程喷火器和两把 Magshot。激光器与喷火器安装在一只手臂，Magshot 则安装在另一只手臂。

column1: An experimental testbed configuration sighted in use among the Blakist Shadow Divisions in 3075, the Caelestis config features a right arm mounted Thunderbolt 10 complimented by a Binary Laser Cannon in each side torso. Support weaponry comes in the form of a pair of Clan-tech ER Small Lasers in the left arm, two Clan ER Mediums in the center torso and a pair of head mounted ER Flamers. A single ton of thunderbolt missiles is carried, while seventeen double heat sinks keep its energy weapons firing.
column2: 这是 3075 年在 Blakist Shadow Divisions 中发现的实验测试平台。Caelestis 配置右臂安装一门 Thunderbolt 10，两侧躯干各有一门 Binary Laser Cannon。支援武器包括左臂两门氏族科技增程小型激光器、中央躯干两门氏族增程中型激光器，以及头部两门增程喷火器。机体携带一吨 Thunderbolt 导弹，十七组双散热器让能量武器能够持续射击。

column1: The Cephalus E carries a Light TAG and ER Large Laser. An extra heat sink helps deal with the heat generated by the configuration.
column2: Cephalus E 携带一具轻型 TAG 和一门增程大型激光器。额外的散热器有助于处理该配置产生的热量。

column1: The Deimos was developed by the Snow Raven Clan and the Mech was first introduced during the middle of the 3060s, allegedly on the Kerensky Cluster world of Lum. However, Inner Sphere intelligence agencies stopped hearing rumors about the 'Mech during the Jihad and it faded from memory. In 3085, the Snow Ravens revealed the existence of the Deimos to the Inner Sphere. It is considered as the pride of the Clan making at least one assigned to every touman. The B variant was geared for general combat with long range weaponry.
column2: Deimos 由 Snow Raven 氏族开发，于 3060 年代中期首次亮相，据称地点是 Kerensky Cluster 的 Lum 世界。然而，圣战期间内圈情报机构不再听到关于这台机甲的消息，它逐渐被遗忘。3085 年，Snow Raven 向内圈公开了 Deimos 的存在。它被视为氏族制造业的骄傲，每个 touman 至少配备一台。B 型专为常规作战和远程武器优化。

column1: Bit more durability at the cost of less weapons. Probably worth it since earlier models struggled with the heat build-up during long engagements.
column2: 牺牲部分武器换取更高耐久性。考虑到早期型号在长时间交战中容易积热，这笔交换或许值得。

column1: A much needed upgrade to the 3V, but still not quite good enough to make it truly useful. Those Rockets just aren't that great.
column2: 这是 3V 的一次急需升级，但仍不够优秀，无法真正实用。那些火箭的表现确实不怎么样。

column1: The Marauder II was first built in 3012 in an attempt to take the firepower of the Marauder and combine it with the reliability and ruggedness of an assault chassis.This Steiner variant was built to carry a Heavy Gauss Rifle.
column2: Marauder II 于 3012 年首次制造，旨在将 Marauder 的火力与突击级底盘的可靠性和坚固性结合起来。这一 Steiner 变体搭载一门重型高斯步枪。

column1: The Marauder MAD-B 'Blight' pairs arm mounted LPPCs with torso mounted UAC/10s. A trio of Light Machine Guns spread across the center torso and head round out the design.
column2: Marauder MAD-B“Blight”将安装在手臂上的轻型 PPC 与躯干上的 UAC/10 结合起来。中央躯干和头部还分布着三挺轻型机枪，使设计更加完整。

column1: Faster than the original Mongoose and with better weapons to boot. This is one nasty mech.
column2: 它比原版 Mongoose 更快，武器也更好。这是一台相当凶狠的机甲。

column1: The Nova Cats introduced this version in 3078. Based on the IIC 5, it keeps the jump capability but replaces all weapons with arm mounted Heavy Large Lasers and Plasma Cannons. A Targeting Computer makes these weapons extremely effective.
column2: Nova Cat 氏族于 3078 年推出这一版本。它基于 IIC 5，保留跳跃能力，但将所有武器替换为手臂安装的重型大型激光器和等离子炮。目标锁定计算机让这些武器极其高效。

column1: A support variant, this configuration carries two Arrow IV missile launchers and four tons of ammunition.
column2: 这是支援型配置，携带两具 Arrow IV 导弹发射器和四吨弹药。

column1: In 3075, in the midst of the Jihad, designers refitted the Sloth by removing the pop-up mine and small lasers in place of an ECM suite and a pair of ER Small Lasers. This system disrupted Word of Blake forces very effectively.
column2: 3075 年圣战期间，设计师拆除 Sloth 的弹出式地雷和小型激光器，换装 ECM 套件与两门增程小型激光器。这套系统非常有效地干扰了 Blake 之言部队。

column1: I pity the fool facing this thing when all four iATM systems get a lock with HE loaded.
column2: 如果这东西的四套 iATM 都锁定目标并装填高爆弹药，我真同情它的对手。

column1: An Advanced Tech version of the Toyama that was introduced during the Jihad. The 1C was re-designed as a fire support 'Mech. Its long-range weaponry includes; an Artemis IV-enhanced LRM-20 Launcher with 2 tons of CASE-protected ammunition and a Gauss Rifle with 2 tons of ammunition. For the 'Mech's secondary weaponry, it has two Medium Variable Speed Pulse Lasers mounted in the right arm. The 'Mech has also been equipped with an XL Gyro and retains the original's Endo Steel.
column2: Toyama 的先进科技版本，于圣战期间推出。1C 被重新设计为火力支援机甲，远程武器包括一具 Artemis IV 增强型 LRM-20 发射器（配备两吨 CASE 保护弹药）和一把高斯步枪（配备两吨弹药）。副武器是安装在右臂的两门中型变速脉冲激光器。机甲还装备 XL 陀螺仪，并保留原版 Endo Steel。

column1: Based upon the 4WA from Arc-Royal MechWorks is this version made to order to incorporate a Chameleon Light Polarization Suite to bring its Capacitor enhanced PPCs close enough for a deadly precision strike.
column2: 该版本基于 Arc-Royal MechWorks 的 4WA 定制制造，加入 Chameleon Light Polarization Suite，让电容器增强型 PPC 能够在安全距离内完成致命的精确打击。

column1: Unlike its cousin, the CRB-21 fields Light Autocannon/5s and MML Launchers, while retaining most of its energy weaponry. Practically every aspect of the 'Mech has been upgraded from the stock version.
column2: 与同族型号不同，CRB-21 使用轻型自动火炮/5 和 MML 发射器，同时保留大部分能量武器。机体几乎每个方面都比标准版本有所升级。

column1: The Bushwacker S2c is a front line that upgrades the AMS to an APD system combined with an ECM to give advanced cover for its units.
column2: Bushwacker S2c 是一台前线型号，将 AMS 升级为 APD 系统，并结合 ECM 为所属单位提供先进掩护。

column1: Although not having the same alpha strike potential as some other loadsouts, this one is flexible with its standard ammunition loadout to deal with several different scenarios a Crossbow can find itself in.
column2: 虽然它的全弹齐射潜力不如某些其他配置，但标准弹药组合十分灵活，可以应对 Crossbow 可能遇到的多种战况。

column1: The difference between the -7M and -7M2 is not that great, but the better heat management of the -7M2 might be better in situations where a full alpha strike is needed.
column2: -7M 与 -7M2 的差异并不大，但 -7M2 更好的散热管理，可能更适合需要全弹齐射的情况。

column1: The Dark Crow is a Clan Snow Raven developed Second Line BattleMech, which was produced only at its Inner Sphere facilities in the Outworlds Alliance after the Jihad. Named after a strange cave-dwelling bird found on Dante, the 'Mech has proven to be a popular design among Second Line troops.
column2: Dark Crow 是 Snow Raven 氏族开发的第二线 BattleMech，圣战后仅在 Outworlds Alliance 的内圈设施生产。它以 Dante 上一种奇特的穴居鸟类命名，在第二线部队中很受欢迎。

column1: The Deimos was developed by the Snow Raven Clan and the Mech was first introduced during the middle of the 3060s, allegedly on the Kerensky Cluster world of Lum. However, Inner Sphere intelligence agencies stopped hearing rumors about the 'Mech during the Jihad and it faded from memory. In 3085, the Snow Ravens revealed the existence of the Deimos to the Inner Sphere. It is considered as the pride of the Clan making at least one assigned to every touman. The C variants tactical capabilities are expanded thanks to the inclusion of an ECM Suite in the center torso, along with the three Improved Jump Jets split between the side torsos.
column2: Deimos 由 Snow Raven 氏族开发，于 3060 年代中期首次亮相，据称地点是 Kerensky Cluster 的 Lum 世界。然而，圣战期间内圈情报机构不再听到关于这台机甲的消息，它逐渐被遗忘。3085 年，Snow Raven 向内圈公开了 Deimos 的存在。它被视为氏族制造业的骄傲，每个 touman 至少配备一台。C 型通过在中央躯干加入 ECM 套件，并将三具改进型跳跃喷射器分装在两侧躯干，扩展了战术能力。

column1: A very mobile 'Mech, the Eris will cause you some headaches unless you deal with it. Its speed and jump capabilities means it can constantly reposition to attack from the flanks with its not insignificant weapons.
column2: Eris 是一台机动性很强的机甲，除非及时处理，否则会给你带来不少麻烦。它的速度和跳跃能力让它能不断重新占位，从侧翼用并不弱的武器发动攻击。

column1: The C Configuration is a Brawler, armed with close-in and hard hitting weaponry which is reminiscent of the original Thor's C Configuration. The Configuration's main gun is a left-torso Ultra Class 20 Autocannon with 3 tons of ammunition split between each of its side torsos. Its other weaponry includes: a pair of arm mounted Large Pulse Lasers, a 4-tubed Streak SRM Launcher, and a Flamer.
column2: C 型是格斗配置，装备近距离、高冲击力武器，令人想起原版 Thor 的 C 型配置。主炮是安装在左侧躯干的 Ultra Class 20 自动火炮，两侧躯干各分担三吨弹药。其他武器包括两门手臂安装的大型脉冲激光器、一具四管 Streak SRM 发射器和一具喷火器。

column1: The M configuration is focused on long range support, carrying only a Rotary AC/2 and a ER Large Laser.
column2: M 型专注于远程支援，只携带一门旋转 AC/2 和一门增程大型激光器。

column1: The Lu Wei Bing is an assault BattleMech first designed in the thirty-second century by Tao 'Mechworks for the Armed Forces of the Capellan Confederation. Physically resembling a slightly heavier Victor, the Lu Wei Bing's weapons layout also echoes the twenty-sixth century 'Mech. First produced in 3110, the Lu Wei Bing was produced as a replacement production design after the Confederation lost its Shengli Arms Assault 'Mech factories to the Federated Suns during the Victoria War.
column2: Lu Wei Bing是Tao机甲工坊在32世纪为卡佩兰联邦武装部队设计的突击战斗机甲。它的外形类似略重的Victor，武器布局也呼应26世纪机甲。Lu Wei Bing于3110年首次生产，作为卡佩兰在维多利亚战争中失去胜利武器突击机甲工厂后的替代生产设计。

column1: The Mongrel is a mixed-tech, medium Clan BattleMech which was originally started as a joint-project between Clan Wolf-in-Exile and the Rasalhague Dominion. Its origin stems from Clan Ghost Bear's need to replace its aging inventory of 'Mechs; in order to accomplish this, a joint project was started between manufacturers in the Rasalhague Dominion and those in the Lyran Commonwealth that produced 'Mechs for Clan Wolf-in-Exile. The two Clan manufacturers desired for the 'Mech to be both inexpensive and combat effective.
column2: Mongrel是混合技术中型氏族战斗机甲，最初由流亡狼氏族与拉萨尔哈格自治领联合开发。它源于鬼熊氏族替换老旧机甲库存的需求；拉萨尔哈格自治领制造商与莱拉联邦制造商共同启动项目，后者为流亡狼氏族生产机甲。两家氏族制造商希望这台机甲既便宜又具备战斗效能。

column1: Black Rose is the personal 'Mech of the legendary Shrike MechWarrior Malvina Hazen, Jade Falcon Star Colonel and later Khan. Her 'Mech was later used as the inspiration for the SRK-3 variant.
column2: Black Rose是传奇Shrike机甲战士、玉鹰氏族星上校及后来的汗王Malvina Hazen的私人机甲。她的机甲后来成为SRK-3型的灵感来源。

column1: A Dark Age configuration, the Strider H carries a pair of clan made Streak LRM-10's and 2 tons of ammo.
column2: 这是黑暗时代配置，Strider H型携带两具氏族制造的Streak LRM-10和两吨弹药。

column1: The Crossfire is a well-known 'Mech once piloted by James "Amalor Myrnnyx" Degenhardt of "Melody's Rockers." Originally a modified UrbanMech "appropiated" from a Periphery training site in 3070, it showcased James's skill as both 'MechWarrior and engineer.
column2: Crossfire是著名机甲，曾由“Melody's Rockers”的James“Amalor Myrnnyx”Degenhardt驾驶。它最初是3070年从外围训练场“征用”的改装UrbanMech，展现了James作为机甲战士和工程师的双重才能。

column1: Boss, I am in awe. This whole mech is built around permanent mounts for those massive Silver Bullet Gauss Rifles. Your classic example of picking your gun and THEN figuring out how to make it move.
column2: 老板，我服了。这整台机甲都围绕那些巨大的银弹高斯步枪固定挂点建造。典型的先选武器，再想办法让它动起来。

column1: I get the feeling whoever put this thing together was expecting to receive a different chassis, and just crammed everything in however they could. It certainly is "shiny" with that AMS running, though.
column2: 我感觉组装这东西的人本来以为会收到另一种底盘，只好把所有东西硬塞进去。AMS启动时确实很“闪亮”。

column1: The SpacerMax was built by MaxTech as a worker 'Mech meant for construction tasks in the vacuum of space, and it helped build the Star League's SDS platforms. Despite being marketed solely for non-atmospheric conditions, it was fully capable of working on the ground too, though that narrow marketing angle ended up hurting its overall sales. Its environmental sealing system was notoriously fragile, and any damage to even one part of it compromised the whole setup, keeping pilots reliant on a delicate lifeline while working out among the stars.
column2: SpacerMax由MaxTech制造，是用于太空真空施工的工人机甲，曾协助建造星盟SDS平台。虽然只面向无大气环境销售，它完全能够在地面工作，但狭窄的营销定位损害了整体销量。环境密封系统出了名地脆弱，哪怕其中一个部件受损都会破坏整个系统，让飞行员在星海施工时依赖一条脆弱的生命线。

column1: Majesty Metals built this one specifically for the MAF, and you can tell they were thinking about real battlefield problems. The mortar is the interesting part. Most people overlook it but it punches through AMS coverage that would stop anything else you could put in that slot. Saw some of these deployed to Cate's Hold after the pirate attack there. Solid, dependable machine. Nothing flashy, just gets the job done.
column2: Majesty Metals专门为MAF制造了这台机甲，看得出他们考虑了真实战场问题。迫击炮是关键。大多数人会忽略它，但它能穿透AMS防护，而同一位置的其他武器都会被AMS拦截。我在海盗袭击Cate's Hold后见过几台部署在那里。坚固、可靠，不花哨，但能完成任务。

column1: Hell's Horses built this one as a proper upgrade for a new age, not just a refit. Sixty tons, same top speed as the original, six jump jets, and four ER Flamers that will cook anything they get near. Every single Clan ended up running these eventually, even the Homeworld ones. Usually listed as second-line but that label undersells what this thing can do in the right hands. The whole Fire Wasp lineage is something special and this is the biggest version of that idea.
column2: 地狱之马氏族制造它是为了新时代的真正升级，而不只是改装。60吨、与原版相同的最高速度、六具跳跃喷射器，以及四具能烤焦附近一切的ER火焰喷射器。最终每个氏族都使用过它，连家园世界氏族也不例外。它通常被列为二线机甲，但这个标签低估了熟练驾驶员手中的实力。整个Fire Wasp谱系都很特别，而这台是该理念最庞大的版本。

column1: Nimakachi Fusion was building these when the Word of Blake hit Tematagi and destroyed the plant. Should have been the end of the design but Wakazashi picked up production in the mid-3070s. The Draconis Combine used them exclusively for a while but by the Dark Age mercenaries and pirates were getting their hands on them through whatever channels they could. Nearly 173 kph in bursts with ECM and an Active Probe running is a hard combination to deal with. The weapons are light but that was never the point.
column2: Nimakachi Fusion在布雷克圣言会袭击Tematagi并摧毁工厂时正在生产这些机甲。设计本应就此终结，但Wakazashi在3070年代中期接手生产。龙马联盟曾一度独家使用，到了黑暗时代，佣兵和海盗通过各种渠道获得了它们。开启ECM和主动探头时，爆发速度接近173公里/小时，很难对付。武器较轻，但这从来不是重点。

column1: The Radius came out of the Jihad in tiny numbers and nearly all of them were destroyed before the war ended, so finding one operational is genuinely unusual. The Word of Blake built it as a network anchor, and in that role it makes every allied unit around it more dangerous without firing a single shot. A mech that wins fights by making its teammates better is a rare thing to find at this weight class. Blake hardware always makes me uneasy, but I cannot argue with what it does.
column2: Radius在圣战末期以极少数量问世，几乎全数在战争结束前被摧毁，因此找到一台仍能运作的实属罕见。布雷克圣言会把它作为网络锚点，使周围每个友军单位都更危险，而无需开一枪。以提升队友来赢得战斗的机甲，在这个重量级别非常少见。布雷克设备总让我不安，但它的效果无可争辩。

column1: I don't know what to say, Boss. Almost every part of this Banshee has been compromised by seemingly random modifications and jury-riggings. I have no idea how it is all holding together, but somehow it is. If you want to use this for your own lances, you might have to find the craziest pilot out there, because this 'Mech is just one unlucky hit away from blowing up in a massive plasma ball.
column2: 老板，我不知道该说什么。这台Banshee几乎每个部件都被随机改装和临时拼接破坏了。我不知道它为何还能撑住，但它确实撑住了。如果你想把它编入自己的长枪，最好找全世界最疯狂的驾驶员，因为这台机甲只差一次倒霉的命中，就会炸成巨大的等离子火球。

column1: Ah, the Catapult P. At first it looks like a perfectly fine C1, but they removed almost all tracking systems and added stubble wings all over it, I have no idea what they wanted to achieve with that.
column2: 啊，Catapult P型。乍看像一台完好的C1，但他们拆掉了几乎所有追踪系统，还在机体各处加装短翼。我完全不知道他们想实现什么。

column1: A Marauder IIC piloted by an infamous Pirate Captain in many battles. The owner, having been 'accidentally' shot by an allied Steiner Mercenary who was 'just taking potshots at an enemy scout lance', decided that the mech would be vastly improved by an advanced CASE system.
column2: 这是一台由臭名昭著的海盗船长驾驶、参加过多场战斗的Marauder IIC。船长被一名声称“只是向敌方侦察长枪随便开几枪”的友军Steiner佣兵“误伤”后，决定用先进CASE系统大幅改进这台机甲。

column1: Looted from a repelled Manei Domini assault on a Pirate Stronghold, this burned-out husk was rebuilt with liberated technology from a research outpost. The insides here are top-notch, but of course the weapons are typical pirate junk.
column2: 这台烧毁的残骸是在一次击退Manei Domini对海盗据点的袭击后缴获的，使用从研究前哨解放的技术重建。内部设备是一流的，但武器当然还是典型的海盗垃圾。

column1: Trust pirates to ruin a perfectly good fire support platform. This has got half the firepower it should in the stock format; and in exchange you get that massive AMS monstrocity.
column2: 相信海盗，他们总能毁掉一台完美的火力支援平台。它只有标准配置一半的火力，换来的却是那座巨大的AMS怪物。

column1: The Uller aptly named for a god of archery sports long range weapons and agility
column2: Uller的名字来自弓箭运动之神，恰如其分地体现了远程武器和敏捷性。

column1: The melee-specialized 'Gemji' CRB-GI has opened its claws, bringing Industrial-strength table flipping to a 'Mech fight.
column2: 专精近战的“Gemji”CRB-GI张开利爪，把工业级掀桌带进了机甲战斗。

column1: Ummm... Huh? It's a 'Mech painted in the color scheme of a Triple F Cheeseburger. And it's got a freaking TOPHAT! This one's got the firing triggers all crosswired together with a big button that has 'Get over here for your Special Sauce, Lettuce, and Cheese' pasted over it.
column2: 呃……什么？这是一台涂成Triple F芝士汉堡配色的机甲，还戴着一顶该死的高帽！它把所有开火扳机交叉接线到一个大按钮上，按钮上贴着“过来领取你的特制酱、莴苣和奶酪”。

column1: Hey, a Quicsell mech that's not a deathrap! Probably mostly because they didn't try to get fancy with it. Other than a slight increased tendency to fall over, this thing is actually pretty sturdy. A good 'kiddies first assault mech' for the trainees.
column2: 嘿，一台不是死亡陷阱的Quicsell机甲！主要是因为他们没试图把它做得花里胡哨。除了更容易摔倒一点，这东西其实相当结实。对训练生来说，是一台不错的“儿童入门突击机甲”。

column1: Bit of an odd one, to be honest. It's got a fair amount of specialty ammo, but those Quicsell launchers go through it twice as fast as normal. At least the 'special guidance' means that the ammo that you do use won't go to waste. Decent all-rounder mech, although you'll probably be better off swapping those SRM launchers out for normal streaks.
column2: 说实话，这台有点奇怪。它携带不少特种弹药，但Quicsell发射器消耗弹药的速度是正常的两倍。至少“特殊制导”意味着你用掉的弹药不会浪费。整体性能尚可，不过最好把SRM发射器换成普通Streak型号。

column1: I can tell why all the promotional material for this mech is about it's speed. They practically forgot the weapons! It's only got four light PPCs, which is pretty sad for a mech this heavy. Not only that, but if you actually manage to hit the enemy with all of them, you'll overheat the mech in one or two volleys unless you're in the freaking arctic.
column2: 如果不是热量输出，这东西装载的PPC会是工程奇迹。“Streak”PPC也许如此，但它们的热量是同等伤害、同等规格正规PPC的两倍。不过如果你的机甲散热能力有限，这倒是个有趣的把戏。

column1: This is a bit a white elephant. It's a mech built around a gun that catastrophically fails after an average of about 20 shots. If you stick some proper UACs in there to replace Quicsell's knock-offs, this could actually make for a decent sniper mech.
column2: 我明白为什么所有宣传材料都在强调它的速度了。他们几乎忘了武器！它只有四门轻型PPC，对这么重的机甲来说很可悲。更糟的是，除非你身处该死的北极，否则只要真的用它们全部命中敌人，一两轮齐射就会让机甲过热。

column1: Look boss, I'm not sure what corners they cut to get this thing to go that fast, but they've got to be big ones. I'd reccomend only putting experienced pilots in this one, since it's blindingly fast but rather unsteady thanks to those damned leg replacements. Oh, and remember that it's got relatively light weapons thanks to so much weight being dedicated to that fusion core.
column2: 这是一头白象。它围绕一门平均开火约20次就会灾难性失效的火炮建造。如果换上真正的UAC取代Quicsell的仿制品，它倒可能成为一台不错的狙击机甲。

column1: I wouldn't call this a mech, so much as a turret that can walk. Keep it away from enemy fire at all costs, since it's only got some machineguns to protect itself at close range. Still, it can put out a lot of bullets, a very long distance.
column2: 老板，我不知道他们为了让它跑得这么快削掉了哪些设计环节，但肯定削得不少。建议只让有经验的驾驶员使用：它快得刺眼，却因为那些该死的腿部替换件而相当不稳定。还要记住，大量重量用于聚变核心，所以武器相对较轻。

column1: Used by RISC as a testbed, this King Crab has been rebuilt from the ground up with experimental technology.
column2: 我不会把这叫作机甲，更像是一座会走路的炮塔。无论如何都要让它远离敌方火力，因为近距离只有几挺机枪自保。不过，它能在很远距离倾泻大量子弹。

column1: Jack Blacks are solid, well-rounded musicians for their tonnage. They typically play guitars, which give them an extra edge by being able to play the greatest song in the world.
column2: RISC将这台King Crab作为测试台使用，从底盘开始以实验技术全面重建。

column1: Commissioned by a Lyran Jockey, the Giftzwerg, or Poisoned Dwarf, greatly boosts the Imp's defensive capacitys.
column2: Jack Blacks是与自身吨位相称、扎实而全面的乐手。他们通常演奏吉他，因此能够演奏“世界上最伟大的歌曲”，获得额外优势。

column1: I can respect when somebody orders a custom job on a 'Mech and they don't ask you to replace every little thing on it. The LB-10-X here slots nicely into where the AC-10 used to be, and those Streak SRMs sit nice and pretty in the old LRM-5 mounts. Feels like an homage to the original — like there's some respect for it.
column2: Giftzwerg，也就是“有毒矮人”，是莱拉骑手委托制造的机甲，大幅提升了Imp的防御能力。

column1: Despite the design being considered obsolete well before the Exodus, the schematics for the Helepolis siege mech survived the journey to the Pentagon Worlds where it went largely ignored until the Golden Century. A small group of Coyote scientists retooled the arcane design, increasing its tonnage and applying most of the weight saving techologies available, and submitted it to their Khan. Despite being rejected as a dishonorable design the HEP-IIC survived in Society caches and has slowly been upgraded over the years. The ZA variant features a pair of Arrow Vs and can only rely on a iATM3 for short-ranged defense.
column2: 我尊重有人为机甲订制改装，却不要求把每个部件都换掉。这里的LB-10-X恰好装进原AC-10的位置，Streak SRM也漂亮地放进旧LRM-5挂点。感觉像是在向原版致敬，说明他们仍然尊重它。

column1: I have long since learned to not ask questions that I don't want the answers to but I need to know: why is 'Old Nicky is a bitch' scratched into the console?
column2: 尽管在大撤离前很久就被认为过时，Helepolis攻城机甲的蓝图仍在前往五角世界的旅途中幸存，直到黄金世纪才基本被忽视。一小群郊狼科学家重新设计了这套古老方案，增加吨位并应用大多数可用的减重技术，然后提交给他们的汗王。尽管被判定为不光彩的设计，HEP-IIC仍在社会氏族缓存中幸存，并逐年缓慢升级。ZA型装备两具箭V，近距离防御只能依靠一具iATM-3。

column1: Ajax突击坦克是一种具备Omni能力的战斗车辆 是GM的Challenger X MBT的后续车型. Ajax紧随成功的Manteuffel万能车辆之后推出. Ajax速度缓慢 最高只能达到54公里/小时. 由于速度不是其防御手段 设计者为Ajax配备了十九吨装甲. 容纳所有这些装甲的空间来自于Ajax所使用的XL引擎. 环境限制: 无. 移动: 3/5格 / 90/150米. 装甲: 装甲 结构: 结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 370 45 左侧 310 45 右侧 310 45 后方 220 45 炮塔 360 45 总计 1570 225 特质: 改良通信 万能车辆 #武器: 1x C3M-TAG 3x LRM-15 1x Ceres粉碎者PPC
column2: Ajax 突击坦克是 GM Challenger X 主战坦克的后继型号，具备全向载具能力。它继承了 Manteuffel 全向载具的成功设计，虽然速度缓慢，却以厚重装甲弥补机动不足。 装甲： 移动: 3/5格 / 90/150米. 结构：装甲 数值 A S结构 前方 左侧 370 45 右侧 310 45 后方 310 45 炮塔 220 45 总计 360 45 1570 225 #武器: 1x C3M-TAG 3x LRM-15 1x Ceres粉碎者PPC
